Pumpkin Scissors (パンプキン・シザーズ)
programme.desc: 2006 — Pumpkin Scissors is a manga created and authored by Ryotaro Iwanaga. Originally serialized in Magazine GREAT in 2002 it was later moved to Monthly Shonen Magazine in October 2006. The manga has been licensed by Del Rey. An anime adaptation of Pumpkin Scissors has been released, produced by Gonzo and AIC, which began airing on October 2, 2006 across several Japanese television stations and ended with the 24th episode on March 19, 2007. The series was originally licensed to the North American market by ADV Films for $780,000. In 2008 it became one of over thirty titles transferred from ADV Films to FUNimation, the main distributor of anime in the English speaking world.

After-Hours Overtime: A Carnivorous Junior’s One-Sided Love Training (『深夜残業〜肉食後輩の片恋研修』)
programme.desc: 2026 — 【A sudden kiss from a younger junior colleague in the office during overtime──!?】 Kuraki Hina, who works at a management consulting firm, receives passionate advances every day from her friendly younger junior colleague, Kurisu Shunsuke. However, Hina brushes them off, not taking his affection seriously. Then one night, while the two of them are working overtime alone in the office, Shunsuke suddenly kisses Hina. His "male" side, unlike his usual innocent junior persona, begins to shake Hina's heart as well... Feelings and jealousy intensify the closer they get. Where will the love of these two, who keep spending sweet nights together, go── A sweet and刺激ive office love story that begins with a kiss during overtime, between an earnest and proactive junior man and a senior woman who is awkward at love.

Pumpkin Scissors (パンプキン・シザーズ)
programme.sub-title: And Yet, the Darkness Remains Unredeemed
programme.desc: 2006 — Pumpkin Scissors is a manga created and authored by Ryotaro Iwanaga. Originally serialized in Magazine GREAT in 2002 it was later moved to Monthly Shonen Magazine in October 2006. The manga has been licensed by Del Rey. An anime adaptation of Pumpkin Scissors has been released, produced by Gonzo and AIC, which began airing on October 2, 2006 across several Japanese television stations and ended with the 24th episode on March 19, 2007. The series was originally licensed to the North American market by ADV Films for $780,000. In 2008 it became one of over thirty titles transferred from ADV Films to FUNimation, the main distributor of anime in the English speaking world.

programme.desc: Set in a hot spring town, this warm-hearted downtown drama follows the ordinary young man Ittetsu Tanonaka, who used to work in Tokyo as a manager and trainer for a women's pro-wrestling team, as he is suddenly forced to serve as the head priest of a temple after his father's sudden death. He had received basic training to become a priest, but for a young man who had lived freely in the city for nearly 10 years after graduating university, the work is a great burden. Thanks to his late father's personality, in a small town like this, the priest's role was not limited to ceremonies but also included everything from advice on worries to welfare work, serving as a catch-all for all kinds of troubles. Longing for his carefree city life, Ittetsu is torn. With the support and encouragement of his mother and sisters, and the help of old friends, this cheerful human drama depicts his growth into a fully fledged head priest. (26 episodes)

Fist of the North Star (世紀末救世主伝説 北斗の拳)
programme.desc: ★ 8.0/10 · 1984 — It's the year 199x, and Earth burns with the fires of a nuclear holocaust. On the charred remains of the planet's surface, humans struggle desperately to survive a fearful world. The young wanderer Kenshiro rises to stand against the violent reality. Upon his chest are seven scars in the shape of the North Star!

programme.title: Shitamachi Rocket (連続ドラマW 下町ロケット)
programme.sub-title: A complete collection of films and dramas based on Jun Ikeido's works
programme.desc: 2015 — Tsukuda Kohei was once a researcher with the Aerospace and Science Exploration Agency and now runs Tsukuda Industries, a small factory which was left by his father. Although his relationship with his teenage daughter Rina is somewhat strained, business at Tsukuda Industries has gradually started to improve. But Tsukuda puts too much effort into his dream of developing a rocket engine and business declines little by little. One day, a major client suddenly declares that it is dropping Tsukuda Industries. Then, Tsukuda Industries gets sued by a big rival company, Nakashima Industries, for patent infringement. Tsukuda Industries’ reputation is hurt and financing from banks is also in a desperate situation. In the midst of this, Teikoku Heavy Industries, one of Japan’s leading corporations, offers to buy a patent which Tsukuda Industries possesses for 2 billion yen

programme.title: The Flying Tire (連続ドラマW 空飛ぶタイヤ)
programme.sub-title: A complete collection of films and dramas based on Jun Ikeido's works
programme.desc: 2009 — A tire comes off a moving truck and becomes a deadly weapon, hitting a mother and child. The problem was caused by the vehicle manufacturer's failure to recall the vehicle, but the blame falls on the head of the delivery company who, despairing, searches for evidence that the recall was suppressed. Crossing paths with banks, police, weekly magazine writers, the victim's family, and various others, he eventually gets to the truth of the matter.

Fist of the North Star: The New Legend of the Savior - Raoh Arc: Chapter of Death in Love (真救世主伝説 北斗の拳 ラオウ伝 殉愛の章)
programme.desc: ★ 6.7/10 · 2006 — A film adaptation of the Holy Emperor story arc, which primarily depicted the conflict between Kenshiro and Souther. New characters Reina, one of Raoh's army officers who falls in love with him, and her brother Soga, Raoh's advisor, play an important part with much of the plot involving Raoh's relationship with Reina as he conquers the land; most of this portion is new content exclusive to this film. The other side of the story is the retelling of Ken's attempt to save and protect the villagers from Souther's army with the help of Shū. There is also a small subplot of Bart returning to his home.

programme.title: Fist of the North Star: The New Legend of the Savior - Yuria Arc (真救世主伝説 北斗の拳 ユリア伝)
programme.desc: ★ 6.4/10 · 2007 — Second part of the new Fist of the North Star movie pentalogy presenting the story from Yuria's perspective, spanning from her childhood, including the day she first met Kenshiro.

programme.title: Fist of the North Star: The New Legend of the Savior - Raoh Arc: Chapter of Fierce Battle (真救世主伝説 北斗の拳 ラオウ伝 激闘の章)
programme.desc: ★ 6.5/10 · 2007 — A film adaptation of the Last Nanto General story arc from the manga, depicting the final battle between Kenshiro and Raoh that led to Kenshiro becoming the successor of Hokuto Shinken. Some events from the manga / anime have been excluded from the story (such as Raoh's fight with Juza) whereas others have been altered or expanded. New content featuring the final battle from Raoh's perspective have been added. This film serves as the follow-up to the first film in the series, which introduced Raoh and Reina's relationship, this time bringing it to a conclusion.

programme.title: Fist of the North Star: The New Legend of the Savior - Toki Arc (真救世主伝説 北斗の拳 トキ伝)
programme.desc: ★ 6.8/10 · 2008 — Fourth part of the new Fist of the North Star movie pentalogy presenting the story from Toki's perspective, leading up to Toki's imprisonment in Cassandra and eventually his duel with Raoh.

programme.title: Fist of the North Star: The New Legend of the Savior - Zero: Kenshiro Arc (真救世主伝説 北斗の拳 ZERO ケンシロウ伝)
programme.desc: ★ 6.7/10 · 2008 — The film's story is a prequel to the Fist of the North Star depicting the one year interval between Kenshiro's defeat at the hands of Shin and their later battle. Unlike the others in the series this film has a completely original storyline in which Kenshiro, near death after his battle with Shin and having used his remaining energy to kill a pack of wolves, was captured by slavers. Due to his strength, Kenshiro could escape whenever he wanted, but chose to stay and protect the other slaves.

programme.title: Roosevelt Game (ルーズヴェルト・ゲーム)
programme.sub-title: A complete collection of films and dramas based on Jun Ikeido's works
programme.desc: 2014 — Based on the same-titled novel by Ikeido Jun (the writer of Hanzawa Naoki series), the drama unfolds against a backdrop of economic recession. Hosokawa Mitsuru is the current president of the core-precision tools manufacturing company, Aoshima. He was personally recruited from another company by the company's founder, Aoshima Takeshi. Needless to say, this move was not well-favored by the existing management who themselves were vying for the job. Not long after Mitsuru joined the company, the global financial crisis caused the economy to slump, and Aoshima was certainly not exempted from the ill-effects of the slump, which was accentuated by fierce competition within the industry. Realising that he needs to stem the company's cashflow crisis, Mitsuru proposes to sell the company's baseball club. However, his proposal is opposed by all the other top management, especially Sasai Kotaro, a long-serving employee who feels that he should have been promoted to President instead of Mitsuru. Mikami Fumio, who is the baseball club's manager, also tries to foil Mitsuru's plans of selling the club. Amidst all the enmity of the long-serving management, and also sabotage from a rival company, Mitsuru has to find a way to save the company from its downfall...

Cutler has a hard time settling into his assignment as he locks horns with his new captain and encounters resistance from the team he must lead. Cutler begins to adjust to his new assignment, starting a budding romance with police psychologist Kim Byers along the way. Unexpectedly, a routine hostage call turns deadly, and a relentless ex-government agent named Walter Hatch vows revenge on Cutler and the entire S.W.A.T. team for killing the woman he loves. programme.desc: 2010 — ¥ 260,000,000 is stolen from armored vehicle. The criminals escape into a crowded shopping mall and take over 50 hostages. Reiko Usagi (Ryoko Yonekura) and the SIT members are called in to break the stand-off. When Reiko goes into the shopping mall to negotiate, an explosion suddenly occurs. The hostages panic and run, while the criminals are able to blend into crowd of people and escape. A few weeks later, Reiko is at the Haneda Airport to go on a vacation. She then spots Yusuke Kimoto (Kento Hayashi), a man who was one of the hostages at the shopping mall. Reiko remembers Yusuke's bizarre behavior and her instinct starts kicking in. She decides to follow the man and boards the airplane that Yusuke is taking. Shortly after take-off her instincts prove correct. The airplane is hijacked ...

programme.title: Blossom (37) Week 8 (【連続テレビ小説】ブラッサム(37)第8週)
programme.desc: Tama (Shizuka Ishibashi), who spends her days in Iwakuni, visits the storehouse filled with memories from her childhood. There, she recalls memories of her father Seiji (Takuro Watabe).

programme.title: Blossom (39) Week 8 (【連続テレビ小説】ブラッサム(39)第8週)
programme.desc: Jin (Shizuka Ishibashi) continues her days working on her manuscript, and at Shuto Koron, which she visits, she meets young writer Ichiro Nishio (Shota Sometani). As completion of her next work draws near, an unexpected visitor comes to see Jin...

programme.title: Asadora: Blossom (40), Week 8 (【連続テレビ小説】ブラッサム(40)第8週)
programme.desc: Tama keeps writing, and finishes her new work, "The Noise of the Town," before the deadline; it is published in Chuto Koron. After finishing her writing, the young writer Ichiro Nishio (Shota Someya) appears again before Tama...

programme.desc: Kuroyanagi Tetsuko is someone who never throws things away. Her home is full of gifts from people she was close to. Enjoy plenty of moving stories about Tetsuko and the stars behind each treasured keepsake!

programme.title: Grand Sumo Tournament (2026) - Kyushu Tournament, Day 14 (大相撲(2026年)九州場所十四日目)

programme.title: Piano Around the Corner, 25 min. (街角ピアノ25min.)
programme.desc: Montreal, Canada's second-largest city. A piano placed in a public market long beloved as the city's "kitchen." What thoughts drive the people who visit there to play a tune? We watched with a fixed camera.

programme.title: Ahead of the broadcast of "The Inugami Family" and "The Devil's Temari Song (Parts 1 & 2)", we present Part 2 of "The Inugami Family"! (「悪魔の手毬唄前後編」放送にむけ「犬神家の一族後編」を放送!)

programme.title: Taiga Drama 'The Toyotomi Brothers!' 2-Minute Digest (45) (大河ドラマ「豊臣兄弟!」2分ダイジェスト(45))
programme.desc: 2026 — Hideyoshi (Sosuke Ikematsu) forbids Hideyori (Taiga Nakano) from seeing him. Worried that the brothers may be drifting apart, Kanbei (Kuranosuke Yuuki) advises Hideyoshi, but he refuses to listen.

programme.title: Haechi (18) (ヘチ王座への道(18))
programme.desc: The story of Prince Lee Geum of the Joseon Dynasty, who wages an unyielding struggle with his companions in pursuit of justice, aiming for a fair world. The king, Gyeongjong, dies, but senior officials oppose Lee Geum's accession to the throne.

programme.title: Seiji Ozawa's Beethoven (小澤征爾のベートーベン)
programme.desc: World-renowned conductor Seiji Ozawa conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in September 2015, when he turned 80.

programme.title: Run! Shinkansen (3) (走れ!新幹線(3))
programme.sub-title: Train lineup E1 series to E7 series / W7 series
programme.desc: From the classic 0 Series to the evolved Shinkansen trains. A 30-minute programme tracing their runs through footage of the E1 Series through E7 / W7 Series. Jewel-like cuts are selected from a vast amount of footage filmed over many years.

programme.title: Run! Shinkansen (4) (走れ!新幹線(4))
programme.sub-title: The Shinkansen seen from the sky
programme.desc: Shinkansen have evolved from the nostalgic 0 Series. A 30-minute programme tracing the speed of the 500 Series, E1 Series and more in aerial footage. Jewel-like cuts are selected from vast footage shot over 50 years.

programme.title: Europe Scenic Roads (ヨーロッパ絶景の道)
programme.desc: "The Beautiful Roads of Europe" brings you beautiful scenery and townscapes from across Europe. This time, we travel the roads of Portugal.

programme.title: Kyoto Saga-Arashiyama: Autumn Leaf Viewing (京都嵯峨嵐山錦秋の紅葉狩り)
programme.desc: Kyoto-Saga Arashiyama is famous for the beauty of its autumn leaves. With a history spanning a thousand years, we introduce famous spots for viewing the fall colors, where you can enjoy landscapes of varying charm that incorporate the natural scenery as borrowed scenery.

programme.title: Island Journey from the Sky: From South to West (空の島旅南から西から)
programme.desc: Featuring breathtaking views of small islands nurtured by rich nature and deep history, with drone footage at the center. This time, the journey goes from Ojima in southern Okinawa northward and eastward. In the end, 13 islands are visited, all the way to Debashima in Tokushima, Shikoku.

programme.title: The Earth of Living Things (生きものたちの地球)
programme.desc: Kangaroo Island in Australia. With music, this program leisurely introduces the rugged coastal scenery and the unique animals that live on the island, such as kangaroos and koalas.

programme.title: One Road Mini (一本の道mini)
programme.sub-title: From one white village to another - Andalusia, Spain
programme.desc: Announcer Makoto Hoshi walked 42 km along the foothills of the Sierra Nevada in Andalusia, Spain. Starting from the white village of Soportújar, the goal is the ruins of a fort dating back to ancient Roman times.

programme.title: Reviving Shin Nihon Kiko Selection (よみがえる新日本紀行選)
programme.sub-title: Taiko drums in a basin city — Chichibu —
programme.desc: "Shin Nihon Kiko" broadcast in Showa 44 is now brought vividly to life with the latest digital technology. It looks at the feelings of the people who, in the harsh natural environment, devote themselves once a year to the magnificent and splendid "Chichibu Night Festival."

programme.title: Seiya Nakai's Scenic Railway Journey: Late Autumn Hyōgo, Riding the Rails Dyed in Brocade! (中井精也の絶景!てつたび晩秋の兵庫錦に染まる鉄路を行く!)
programme.desc: Railway photographer Nakai Seiya rediscovers the wonders of local railways. This time, he travels along three lines in southern Hyogo in late autumn. Getting off along the way, he interacts with local people while capturing spectacular scenery on camera.

programme.title: Honmamon (30) (【連続テレビ小説】ほんまもん(30))
programme.desc: Yamanaka Konoha, the heroine, was born and raised in the mountain villages of Kumano, Wakayama Prefecture. Armed with her naturally gifted sense of taste, inherited from her father, she enters the world of cooking, where harsh training awaits. A morning drama series broadcast in 2001.

programme.title: The Art of Beauty (美の壺)
programme.desc: 2006 — The beauty of shippo, with its jewel-like colors and light created by the ultimate in craftsmanship. From shippo jewelry to the extraordinary techniques of a genius of the Meiji era, and on to contemporary artists who breathe new life into tradition. The infinitely shining universe of shippo!

programme.title: Earth Taxi 15 min. Drive (地球タクシー15min.ドライブ)
programme.sub-title: The true feelings of the young people racing through Kathmandu
programme.desc: "Earth Taxi" is a travel documentary with a twist, letting you feel the cities of the world through conversation with the driver and the scenery outside the window. A spin-off from the series, this 15-minute drive lets you experience a city in just 15 minutes!

programme.title: Morning Drama: Blossom (41) Week 9 (【連続テレビ小説】ブラッサム(41)第9週)
programme.desc: Tama (Shizuka Ishibashi) was wondering what to choose for her new work's subject. While talking with Ichiro Nishio (Shota Sometani) at a coffee shop, Tama confides, “Actually, I've been thinking of writing about my father,” but...

programme.title: Blossom (42) Week 9 (【連続テレビ小説】ブラッサム(42)第9週)
programme.desc: A reporter writes about how close Tama (Shizuka Ishibashi) and Ichiro (Shota Sometani) seem, out of mere curiosity, and the two unexpectedly attract public attention.

programme.title: Blossom (43), Week 9 (【連続テレビ小説】ブラッサム(43)第9週)
programme.desc: Tama (Shizuka Ishibashi) invites her best friend, newspaper reporter Shinobu (Mao Kiryu), to a coffee shop and candidly opens up about what is in her heart.

programme.title: [Asadora] Blossom (44) Week 9 (【連続テレビ小説】ブラッサム(44)第9週)
programme.desc: After reading a handwritten account published in the newspaper that recorded Tama's true feelings, Ho (Daichi Kaneko) visits Tama (Shizuka Ishibashi), and the two finally speak honestly about their true feelings.

programme.title: Blossom (45) Week 9 (【連続テレビ小説】ブラッサム(45)第9週)
programme.desc: After Tamotsu (Daichi Kaneko) returns to Hokkaido, Tama (Shizuka Ishibashi) focuses on writing and finishes a new work about her father, titled Father of Reminiscence.

programme.title: Wildlife: Canada — The Mysterious White Sea Where Whales Gather and Wolves Come Alive (ワイルドライフカナダ神秘の白い海クジラが集いオオカミが躍動する)
programme.desc: Spring on the west coast of Canada. Triggered by a phenomenon that turns the sea white, large animals such as whales and sea lions gather, and even wolves emerge from the forest. A look at the spectacle unfolding in the mysterious white sea.

programme.title: BS Special: In Search of a Unique "Perfection" — The 21-Year Journey of Kaori Sakamoto (BSスペシャル唯一無二の“完璧”を求めて〜坂本花織・21年間の軌跡〜)
programme.desc: Figure skater Kaori Sakamoto won a silver medal at her final Olympics. She has fought by perfecting her technique and accumulating small scores. This program traces her journey through close-up coverage and exclusive footage.

programme.title: 2026 NHK Trophy Figure Skating: Ice Dance Free Dance (2026NHK杯フィギュアアイスダンスフリーダンス)
programme.desc: *The in-house audio commentary will continue with the sounds from the arena - Chofu City, Tokyo - Broadcast live from Keio Arena TOKYO - [Continues on General TV]

programme.title: Sport Power! A Town Where Nadeshiko Bloom: Viamateras Miyazaki and Shintomi Town (スポヂカラ!なでしこたちが咲きほこる町にヴィアマテラス宮崎と新富町)
programme.desc: A sports program hosted by Atsushi Tamura. This time, we head to Shintomi Town in Miyazaki Prefecture. It's an unprecedented town-building project: using a local revitalization team to create a women's soccer team. We take a close look at the sports power born from Via Materas Miyazaki.

programme.title: J.League 2026-27 J1 Round 17: Shimizu S-Pulse vs. (Jリーグ2026-27J1第17節「清水エスパルス」対)
programme.desc: A live broadcast of the match between Shimizu S-Pulse and Urawa Reds! The struggling S-Pulse are in a tough battle—can they secure a home win? At halftime, take a look at the stadium's prized turf, which has been crowned Japan's best for eight consecutive years.

programme.title: RAMEN JAPAN: Chiba (RAMENJAPAN千葉)
programme.desc: - This time, we'll be introducing a local ramen specialty from Chiba!

programme.title: Easy as Pie: To the Young Toyotomi Brothers! Why Did the Toyotomi Brothers Destroy the Hōjō Clan? (秀サルでもわかる豊臣兄弟!なんで豊臣兄弟は北条氏を滅ぼしたの?)
programme.desc: The official guide to enjoying the historical drama "Toyotomi Brothers!" even more. Packed with eye-opening information. Two little monkeys explain the historical background and complex human relationships in a very easy-to-understand way.

programme.title: NHK ONE Educational Promo Mini-Program (NHKONE教養PRミニ番組)
programme.desc: ■ No programme details available.

programme.title: The Ballad of Mataro the Devil [promo] (悪魔の手毬唄PR)
programme.desc: Based on Seishi Yokomizo's novel. The fifth installment of NHK's Kindaichi Kosuke series. The great detective takes on the mystery of a series of murders that occur just as an old handball song foretells. The charm of this gem of a mystery, presented in two parts, is condensed into one minute!

programme.title: Columbo (58) (刑事コロンボ(58))
programme.desc: Fresh and exciting no matter how many times you watch it! A masterpiece of mystery drama. Peter Falk received an Emmy nomination for this work. Legendary rock star Little Richard also appears as himself!

programme.title: Raising Cats, Raising Dogs: Moving Reunion Special (ねこ育ていぬ育て感動の再会スペシャル)
programme.desc: Since 2019, "Neko Sodate Inu Sodate" has been following families who welcomed rescue cats and dogs. Are they all living happily now? Visiting them again after several years reveals a moving story of growth.

programme.title: Chinese Dynasty Winds and Clouds: Jirō Asada x Emperor, a 2,000-Year Journey (中国王朝風雲録浅田次郎×皇帝2000年の旅)
programme.desc: Two thousand years from Qin Shi Huang's Qin dynasty to the last dynasty, the Qing. The emperors who ruled over the dynasties hold clues to understanding China. Traveling with Jiro Asada to the sites of new discoveries, we explore the secrets of imperial rule.

programme.title: The Devil's Temari Song, Part 1 (悪魔の手毬唄前編▽横溝正史の傑作ミステリーを大ボリュームでドラマ化!)
programme.desc: Based on Seishi Yokomizo's novel. The fifth instalment in NHK's Kindaichi Kosuke series! A series of murders occurs exactly as described in the old handball song handed down in the village! The great detective takes on the mystery! Broadcast in a huge three-hour version across two parts.

programme.title: The Ballad of Mataro the Devil [promo] (悪魔の手毬唄PR)
programme.desc: Based on a novel by Seishi Yokomizo. The fifth installment of the NHK Kindaichi Kosuke series, with a series of murders occurring one after another. Yet no clue to the culprit can be found. A gem of a mystery, its appeal and story condensed into one minute in this second half!

programme.title: Tiny desk concerts JAPAN: Magokoro Brothers (tinydeskconcertsJAPAN真心ブラザーズ)
programme.desc: Magokoro Brothers make their tinydesk debut! A special performance in Hiroshima, a place linked to them! Includes the big hits "Summer Nude" and "Hello, John Lennon," plus a cover of Hiroshima native Takuro Yoshida's "Ryusei"!

programme.title: Daitoku-ji: The Essence of Zen Told Through Its Treasures (大徳寺〜名宝が物語る禅の神髄〜)
programme.desc: This year marks the 700th anniversary of the founding of Daitoku-ji, which preserves many famous paintings and cultural treasures imbued with the spirit of Zen. Actor Yutaka Matsushige visits Daitoku-ji and approaches the essence of Zen while unraveling the stories behind its treasures.

programme.title: ABBA Concert 1979 (洋楽倶楽部アバコンサート1979)
programme.desc: An audiovisual work centered on ABBA’s 1979 London concert. This version is presented in digital remastering (video restoration).

programme.title: A 1-Minute Promo for "What Is My Worth in This Crisis? (「今ここにある危機とぼくの好感度について」1分PR)
programme.desc: 2021 — Matsuzaka Tori, starring in the 2027 taiga drama "Gyakuzoku no Bakushin," plays a young man working in a university public relations office. Jostled by the various problems the university faces, he finds his own way of life in this black comedy.

programme.title: LP Record Stories (16) Taiyōshin (LPレコードストーリーズ(16)太陽神)
programme.desc: Earth, Wind & Fire's "The Sun God." Jacket artwork by Japanese painter/illustrator Shusei Nagaoka. The secret Japanese words hidden in the hieroglyphs

programme.desc: A nonstop Western music program. We bring you performance videos by 19 artists from the music show "THEROXY," broadcast in the UK in the 1980s.

programme.title: Festivals of the World: Spain, Pamplona's Bull Run (世界の祭りスペイン・パンプローナ牛追い祭り)
programme.desc: The bull-running festival eagerly awaited by the people of Pamplona, a city in Spain's northern Basque Country. For nine summer days, the city comes together for this magnificent festival, presented with powerful images and sound.

programme.title: Hokkaido: Cute Animals — From Sawayaka Shizen Hyakkei (北海道・かわいい動物たち〜さわやか自然百景から〜)
programme.desc: "Sawayaka Shizen Hyakkei" has introduced the nature, landscapes, and living creatures found throughout Japan. From footage shot in Hokkaido, we bring you plenty of adorable animal moments!

programme.title: Japan's Famous Peaks (日本の名峰)

programme.title: Deep Ocean (ディープオーシャン)
programme.desc: 2015 — A magnificent visual journey through Antarctica's breathtaking scenery and wildlife. With original music by Joe Hisaishi and only captions to tell the story, this filler footage lets you experience the last frontier, "Antarctica."

programme.title: Para-Do: Graceful Dance (パラ道華麗な舞)
programme.desc: A world-class top dancer, KENZO, takes a deep dive into the appeal of para street dance, where blind cane dancers and wheelchair dancers shine with individuality! Para equestrianism in pursuit of ultimate beauty. What is the secret behind the performance that unites horse and rider as one!

programme.title: Japan's 100 Famous Mountains: Revival! Traverse Route to an Active Volcano — Kubiki Sanzan (にっぽん百名山復活!活火山への縦走路〜頚城三山〜)
programme.desc: The "Kujigisan Mountains" in Niigata Prefecture. The route that fully traverses Myoko, Hiuchiyama and Yakeyama has only recently been revived in 2022. A mountain journey that lets you encounter the many faces of these three distinctive peaks.

programme.title: Angler's Paradise: Boat 'Egi' Fun, Autumn Cuttlefish Fishing — Shunsuke Daito, Fukui, Tsuruga (釣りびと万歳船で“エギ”遊び秋のアオリイカ釣り〜大東駿介福井・敦賀〜)
programme.desc: They target hand-sized spear squid in Wakasa Bay. They jerk the rod, make the egi swim, and lure them in, but it's not easy. What's more, the bites are subtle. This is a highly difficult form of fishing. How will the catch turn out?

programme.title: Shin Nihon Fudoki (新日本風土記)
programme.desc: 2011 — The Sea of Japan is full of attractions, from cuisine to culture. This program re-edits and presents a selection of gems. The hatahata fish fishermen await, the taste of kombu brought by the kitamaebune cargo ships, the sounds created by technologies imported from the continent... A journey through the Sea of Japan.

programme.desc: A volcanic site where you can see glowing red magma up close, a crystal-blue spring radiating indescribable beauty... Experience the Earth in Vanuatu, one of the world's leading volcanic archipelagos in the South Pacific!

programme.desc: Enjoy the unique culture and history of Scotland in northern Britain, along with spectacular natural scenery. Edinburgh Castle and Cathedral, the castle on Loch Ness, and railway scenes too! And the setting of Macbeth.

programme.title: Scenery from the Driver's Seat: Kintetsu Nara Line (運転席からの風景近鉄奈良線)
programme.desc: The Kintetsu Nara Line is also a tourist route from Osaka to Nara. Enjoy views of the Osaka Plain from the train window, pass through the Ikoma Tunnel, and head to the ancient capital, now a UNESCO World Heritage site.

programme.desc: A piece composed during Chopin's most fulfilling period. Behind it lay the brief but rich life he shared with his lover, George Sand. We also take a look at the manor in Nohant where they spent most of their time.

programme.title: Piano on the Street (街角ピアノ)
programme.desc: Montreal, Canada's second-largest city. A piano placed in a public market long beloved as the city's "kitchen." What thoughts drive the people who visit there to play a tune? We watched with a fixed camera.

programme.title: Street Piano Vol. 1 (街角ピアノvol.1)
programme.desc: Kobe, Hyogo Prefecture, is said to be the city with the most street pianos in Japan. In a popular underground shopping arcade loved by residents, there is a grand piano that everyone enjoys. In this city full of music, what melodies will people play?

programme.desc: Palau, a paradise in the Pacific. A world-class coral reef stretches out here, home to 1,500 kinds of uniquely fascinating fish. Take a 4K underwater stroll through the crystal-clear blue sea and enjoy Palau's magnificent nature.

programme.title: Airport Piano (空港ピアノ)
programme.desc: In February 2021, the "Reconstruction Piano" was installed for a limited time at Sendai Airport. This piano was damaged by the tsunami and brought back to life from the debris. A fixed camera watches the people who play it.

programme.title: Classical Music Club: Shiori Kuwahara Piano Recital, Tottori Prefecture Nichinan Town Public Recording (クラシック倶楽部桑原志織ピアノ・リサイタル鳥取県日南町公開収録)
programme.desc: Shiho Kuwahara, fourth place at the 19th Chopin Competition, appears! We bring you exquisite piano works, including the Ballade No. 4 she performed at the competition and Bach=Busoni's Chaconne.

programme.title: Album of Masterpieces: From the Opera Cavalleria rusticana (名曲アルバム歌劇「カヴァレリア・ルスティカーナ」から)
programme.desc: Soprano: Atsuko Kobayashi Chorus: Fujiwara Opera Chorus Orchestra: NHK Symphony Orchestra Conductor: Ken Koseki [Location] Catania, Vizzini (Sicily, Italy)

programme.title: Morning Drama: Honmamon (25) (【連続テレビ小説】ほんまもん(25))
programme.desc: Yamanaka Konoha, the heroine, was born and raised in the mountain villages of Kumano, Wakayama Prefecture. Armed with her naturally gifted sense of taste, inherited from her father, she enters the world of cooking, where harsh training awaits. A morning drama series broadcast in 2001.

programme.title: Morning Drama: Blossom (41) Week 9 (【連続テレビ小説】ブラッサム(41)第9週)
programme.desc: Tama (Shizuka Ishibashi) was wondering what to choose for her new work's subject. While talking with Ichiro Nishio (Shota Sometani) at a coffee shop, Tama confides, “Actually, I've been thinking of writing about my father,” but...

programme.title: Nippon Tabi Kokoro Tabi Encore, Week 322: Miyazaki Prefecture (にっぽん縦断こころ旅おかわり322週目宮崎県)
programme.desc: This week's Koko Tabi features an encore of “Okawari” in the morning! This day is from March 2025, when Misako Tanaka, as the second traveller, made her first journey through Miyazaki Prefecture. Full of nostalgic highlights!

programme.title: Great Nature: The Andes' Sky-High Volcanic Zone, Argentina — The Pulse of 200 Million Years (体感!グレートネイチャーアンデス天空の火山地帯アルゼンチン2億年の鼓動)
programme.desc: Strange rock towers, snowy mountain ridges, lakes of mysterious colors, peaks like cathedrals... Why were these mysterious spectacular sights born in the Andes of South America? We explore the mystery of volcanic activity spanning more than 200 million years!

programme.title: A Man for All Seasons (シネマ4K「わが命つきるとも」<字幕スーパー><レターボックスサイズ>)
programme.desc: ★ 7.3/10 · 1966 — In the 16th century, it depicts the life of Thomas Somore, who was executed in protest against King Henry VIII's divorce in England, with dignified visual beauty, and won six Academy Awards including Best Picture, making it an immortal masterpiece.

programme.title: Journey to the Towns of the Stars (宇宙(ほし)の街紀行)
programme.sub-title: Austria Vienna Museum of Natural History
programme.desc: The Museum of Natural History in Vienna, the city of art. An enormous number of fossils and minerals were collected there by imperial taste. Introducing the collection of the world’s largest meteorite exhibition room, with 650 types and 1,100 items.

programme.title: Japan's 100-Year Heritage ~ Stories of Long-Established Shops for the Future ~ The Craft of Kiriko Passed Down in Horikiri, Katsushika, Tokyo (日本100年遺産~未来へ贈る老舗物語~職人がつなぐ切子の技東京葛飾区堀切)
programme.desc: A story of a long-established business with over 100 years of history. This time, the setting is a small workshop that produces the beautiful glass craft called Edo Kiriko, also used in the interior of the Tokyo Skytree.

programme.title: Nippon Tabi Kokoro Tabi Encore, Week 322: Miyazaki Prefecture (にっぽん縦断こころ旅おかわり322週目宮崎県)
programme.desc: This week's Koko Tabi features an encore of “Okawari” in the morning! This day is from March 2025, when Misako Tanaka, as the second traveller, made her first journey through Miyazaki Prefecture. Full of nostalgic highlights!

programme.title: Tsuribito Banzai: Catch the Giant Flatfish of Ishikari Bay ~ Shoei in Hokkaido / Otaru ~ (釣りびと万歳石狩湾の“座布団ヒラメ”を釣り上げろ~照英北海道・小樽~)
programme.desc: In winter off the coast of Otaru, Hokkaido, large flatfish over 50 cm reach their peak season in the Ishikari Bay. Taking on the challenge is entertainer and renowned angler Shoei. Can he reel in the “cushion flatfish”?

programme.title: The World's Hardest-to-Enter Izakaya: Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia — The Super-Regulars Never Leave (世界入りにくい居酒屋モンゴル・ウランバートル超常連が居座る)
programme.desc: Mongolia, a country of nomads. In the capital, Ulaanbaatar, there is an izakaya so comfortable that its super-regulars have practically "moved in." What is the charm that makes customers happily linger there?

programme.title: The Art of Beauty (美の壺)
programme.sub-title: The refined artistry of Edo sashimono
programme.desc: 2006 — Edo sashimono are crafted by assembling wood without nails. From the drawer box used by shogi player Yoshiharu Habu to the makeup mirror in the dressing room of kabuki actor Kangyoku Nakamura, we explore this profound world in depth!

programme.title: Great Choices: Shogun Iesada Tokugawa XII — Judging the "Sanpō Ryōchi Gae (英雄たちの選択十二代将軍・徳川家慶「三方領知替え」を裁く)
programme.desc: The turmoil of the Bakumatsu era began with the arrival of the Black Ships. But even before that, the shogunate was already in decline. The people of the land stage a major protest against the shogunate’s order to transfer the domains of the daimyo. Repeal or carry it out - what will Shogun Iesada decide?

programme.title: Speeding Through the Taklamakan Desert Railway: A Winter Silk Road Journey (疾走!タクラマカン砂漠鉄道~冬のシルクロードをゆく~)
programme.desc: Traveling in winter on the Taklamakan Desert Ring Railway, which only recently opened the Silk Road to the season. Ride over the giant iron bridge across the dunes and visit descendants of the Kingdom of Loulan and a mysterious people. The highlight is the stunning desert scenery shining silver-white in the snow.

programme.title: The Ballad of Mataro the Devil [promo] (悪魔の手毬唄PR)
programme.desc: Based on a work by Seishi Yokomizo. The fifth installment of NHK's Kindaichi Kousuke series, "Akuma no Temari Uta," has been confirmed for broadcast on NHK-BS! The charm of this gem of a mystery, presented in two parts, is condensed into one minute!

programme.title: Journey on Europe's Rivers (ヨーロッパ川の旅)
programme.sub-title: The Danube River of Empress Elisabeth
programme.desc: Travel along the Rhine, Main, Danube and canals aboard a luxurious river cruise ship. An epic river journey across the European continent. Soak up breathtaking scenery and history and culture with vivid realism.

programme.title: Yamato's Seasons: The 24 Solar Terms - Whispering Water, Light Snow (やまとの季節二十四節気水のささやき小雪)
programme.desc: A film poet of the seasons, created by the lights and sounds of a one-time encounter. The Kasugayama primeval forest, filmed by video artist Koichi Hozan, who lives in Nara, and original music performed by pianist Mine Kawakami. A visual poem that lets you feel the season.

programme.title: Columbo (64) (刑事コロンボ(64))
programme.desc: New every time you watch it! A landmark of mystery drama. Based on Ed McBain's "87th Precinct" series. A photo cut up like a jigsaw puzzle held the clue to where a fortune was hidden!

programme.title: Spectacular Swiss Alps (絶景スイスアルプス)
programme.desc: A journey by image through the spectacular scenery of the Swiss Alps. Explore the Aletsch Glacier, the longest glacier in Europe. Encounter a variety of breathtaking sights, including a deep-blue pool formed in a huge crevasse and glacier waterfalls.

programme.title: Gaudi's Seven World Heritage Sites (4) (ガウディ7つの世界遺産(4))
programme.desc: A series introducing the seven World Heritage sites left behind by Antoni Gaudí, the genius architect Spain gave the world. In episode 4: Park Güell, the "park with the dragon."

programme.title: Fisherman's Cheers: Playing with Egi - Autumn Bigfin Reef Squid Fishing ~Daisuke Daidō, Fukui/Tsuruga~ (釣りびと万歳船で“エギ”遊び秋のアオリイカ釣り~大東駿介福井・敦賀~)
programme.desc: They target hand-sized spear squid in Wakasa Bay. They jerk the rod, make the egi swim, and lure them in, but it's not easy. What's more, the bites are subtle. This is a highly difficult form of fishing. How will the catch turn out?

programme.title: Great Traverse: Mountain Old Road, Salt Road (4) - Long Traverse of the Ina Mountains! (グレートトラバース山岳古道・塩の道(4)伊那山地大縦走!)
programme.desc: [Featuring] Pro adventure racer... Yōki Tanaka

programme.title: Nippon Journey of the Heart: Archive Special (にっぽん縦断こころ旅蔵出しスペシャル)
programme.desc: This week's "Kokoro Tabi" is a "special archive edition" in the daytime (BS only) and at night! This day features the trip through Miyazaki Prefecture in March 2025, when Tanaka Misako rode for the first time as the second traveler! Packed with memorable scenes!

programme.title: Experience! Great Nature Selection Special (体感!グレートネイチャー選SP)
programme.sub-title: The breathtaking scenery of Siberia’s frozen land
programme.desc: A series of breathtaking sights created by 70-below-zero cold. The distorted sun, great rivers frozen solid, Lake Baikal, boasting the world’s clearest waters, and forests sustained by permafrost are depicted through the changing seasons.

programme.title: Agatha Christie: Miss Marple (アガサ・クリスティーミス・マープル)
programme.desc: An encore broadcast of the popular A. Christie series from season 1! A disliked colonel is murdered. Marple sees through the culprit's cunning method.

programme.title: A New Japan's Landscape [Selection] (新日本風土記選)
programme.sub-title: Between the mountains and the sea of Nanki Shirahama
programme.desc: The people of Nanki, Kishu, have been forged by harsh nature. A former zookeeper rising up after the panda loss, a plum farmer battling abnormal weather, young people taking on eel farming, and a story from summer to autumn that overcomes trials (broadcast in 2025

programme.title: Western Music Club: Oasis Live in Manchester 2005 (洋楽倶楽部オアシスライブインマンチェスター2005)
programme.desc: A concert by rock band Oasis in 2005 at their hometown football stadium in Manchester, UK. Presented in digitally remastered (video restored) footage.

programme.title: Cruising from the Sky Special: Seaside Scenery of Malta (空からクルージング特別編マルタ海辺の風景)
programme.desc: A journey by air along the coastline of the small Mediterranean nation of Malta. Enjoy a full introduction to breathtaking scenery and history, including the azure sea, white limestone cliffs and caves, old harbors, megalithic temples over 5,000 years old, and salt pans.

programme.title: 8K Experience! Fixed-Point Shooting Series "Touring Fireworks Around Japan": Hokkaido Arts Fireworks (8K体感!定点撮影シリーズ「全国花火めぐり」北海道芸術花火)
programme.desc: Experience the realism of being there with ultra-high-definition fixed-camera footage in 8K in the "Fixed-Point Shooting Series." This time, enjoy footage of the 2024 Hokkaido Geijutsu Hanabi.

programme.title: 8K European Tram Journey (20) (8Kヨーロッパトラムの旅(20))
programme.desc: A tram journey through Europe. This time, the Route 3 in Rome, the capital of Italy. Travel from Porta Maggiore to Villa Borghese Park, a popular place for locals to relax.

programme.title: Images Walk: The Great Adventure of Tara-go (映像散歩タラ号の大冒険)
programme.desc: ■ No programme details available.

programme.title: Video Poetry: The Melody of Kasuga (映像詩春日の調べ)
programme.desc: A superbly filmed account of the four seasons of Nara Kasuga Taisha. A visual poem by filmmaker Koichi Hozan and pianist Mine Kawakami, active worldwide.

programme.title: Poetic Images of Life: The Seasons of Yamato, from Summer to Autumn (命の映像詩やまとの季節夏から秋へ)
programme.desc: The changing seasons from summer to autumn as filmed by video artist Koichi Hoyama, who lives in Nara. The once-in-a-lifetime images and the music played by pianist Mine Kawakami. A poetic visual work that lets you feel the season through resonant sound and light.

programme.title: Airport Piano (空港ピアノ)
programme.desc: In February 2021, the "Reconstruction Piano" was installed for a limited time at Sendai Airport. It is a piano that was drenched by the tsunami and brought back to life from the rubble. What thoughts run through the minds of the people who come to play it?

programme.title: Classical Club: Ryota Komatsu & Quartetto Excelsior ~ Public Recording in Yasugi City (クラシック倶楽部小松亮太&クァルテット・エクセルシオ~安来市公開収録)
programme.desc: Ryota Komatsu, a bandoneon player leading the tango world, and Quartetto Excelsior, one of Japan's leading string quartets. Enjoy a generous helping of this genre-crossing collaboration.

programme.desc: A piece composed during Chopin's most fulfilling period. Behind it lay the brief but rich life he shared with his lover, George Sand. We also take a look at the manor in Nohant where they spent most of their time.

programme.title: Honmamon (26) (【連続テレビ小説】ほんまもん(26))
programme.desc: Yamanaka Konoha, the heroine, was born and raised in the mountain villages of Kumano, Wakayama Prefecture. Armed with her naturally gifted sense of taste, inherited from her father, she enters the world of cooking, where harsh training awaits. A morning drama series broadcast in 2001.

programme.title: Blossom (42) Week 9 (【連続テレビ小説】ブラッサム(42)第9週)
programme.desc: A reporter writes about how close Tama (Shizuka Ishibashi) and Ichiro (Shota Sometani) seem, out of mere curiosity, and the two unexpectedly attract public attention.

programme.title: Japan Journey: Kokoro Tabi Encore, Week 323, Ōita Prefecture (にっぽん縦断こころ旅おかわり323週目大分県)
programme.desc: This week's "Kokoro Tabi" morning encore features "O-Kawari"! This day was in March 2025, in Oita Prefecture. Highlight scenes and unreleased footage, plus the "landscape of the heart" that Misako was unable to visit!

programme.title: Wildlife: Canada — The Mysterious White Sea Where Whales Gather and Wolves Come Alive (ワイルドライフカナダ神秘の白い海クジラが集いオオカミが躍動する)
programme.desc: Spring on the west coast of Canada. Triggered by a phenomenon that turns the sea white, large animals such as whales and sea lions gather, and even wolves emerge from the forest. A look at the spectacle unfolding in the mysterious white sea.

programme.desc: High-definition special: Journey through the World Natural Heritage sites. The world’s largest waterfall—Iguazu National Park—depicts the wonders of nature with powerful images and sound. (First broadcast: 2003)

programme.desc: A story of a long-established shop with over 100 years of history. This time, the setting is a sweet sake shop that has stood for generations in the heart of Kanda Myojin. It preserves the koji born in a room used since the early Edo period.

programme.title: Japan Journey: Kokoro Tabi Encore, Week 323, Ōita Prefecture (にっぽん縦断こころ旅おかわり323週目大分県)
programme.desc: This week's "Kokoro Tabi" morning encore features "O-Kawari"! This day was in March 2025, in Oita Prefecture. Highlight scenes and unreleased footage, plus the "landscape of the heart" that Misako was unable to visit!

programme.title: Seiya Nakai's Scenic Railway Journey: Late Autumn Hyōgo, Riding the Rails Dyed in Brocade! (中井精也の絶景!てつたび晩秋の兵庫錦に染まる鉄路を行く!)
programme.desc: Railway photographer Nakai Seiya rediscovers the wonders of local railways. This time, he travels along three lines in southern Hyogo in late autumn. Getting off along the way, he interacts with local people while capturing spectacular scenery on camera.

programme.title: A Walk Around the World (世界ふれあい街歩き)
programme.desc: 2018 — Sofia, the capital of Bulgaria. Walk through a "crossroads of civilizations" where Eastern and Western cultures mix: the hot springs loved by Roman emperors, mosques from the Ottoman era, traditional instruments, and more. [Narration] Tomoko Nakajima, Yoichi Nukumizu

programme.title: Darwin's Amazing Animals (ダーウィンが来た!)
programme.sub-title: A battle of destiny! Desert giraffe vs. desert lion
programme.desc: 2006 — There are giraffes in the Namib Desert! They are called "desert giraffes." How can they survive in the scorching desert? Their astonishing abilities are revealed one after another! A close look at their life-or-death struggle against their nemesis, the desert lion!

programme.title: Europe’s Secret Hot Springs Journey: Plat-Barrège Onsen, France (ヨーロッパ秘湯ジャーニーフランスプラット・バラゲー温泉)
programme.desc: Europe's hidden hot spring, "Pratt-Barrage Hot Springs" in the Pyrenees of southern France. Enjoy a relaxing moment at this famous bath nestled in the forest.

programme.title: The Forbidden City: The Emperor's Hidden Garden (紫禁城皇帝の知られざる花園)
programme.desc: The imperial palace of China, the Forbidden City. Deep inside, the emperor created a hidden garden. (Qianlong Garden) With writer Jiro Asada, we explore the unseen buildings, the history and worldview they embody. Featuring Shinnosuke Mitsushima.

programme.title: Reviving New Japan Journey: Selected — Drum in the Basin, Chichibu (よみがえる新日本紀行選盆地の太鼓-秩父-)
programme.desc: The 1969 broadcast New Japan Journey is brought vividly back to life with the latest digital technology. In harsh natural surroundings, we look at the feelings of the people who devote themselves, once a year, to the splendid and magnificent Chichibu Night Festival.

programme.title: The Ballad of Mataro the Devil [promo] (悪魔の手毬唄PR)
programme.desc: Based on a work by Seishi Yokomizo. The fifth installment of NHK's Kindaichi Kousuke series, "Akuma no Temari Uta," has been confirmed for broadcast on NHK-BS! The charm of this gem of a mystery, presented in two parts, is condensed into one minute!

programme.title: Still in Time for a BS Period Drama (まだ間に合うBS時代劇)
programme.desc: In an Edo-Fukagawa row house, Oichi (Wakana Aoi), who dreams of becoming a doctor, helps her father, the doctor Shoan (Hiroshi Tamaki). A detective period drama and a coming-of-age story about Oichi, who aspires to become a doctor for women.

programme.title: Street Piano, Vol. 2 (街角ピアノvol.2)
programme.desc: Kobe, Hyogo Prefecture, is said to be the city with the most street pianos in Japan. In a popular underground shopping arcade loved by residents, there is a grand piano that everyone enjoys. In this city full of music, what melodies will people play?

programme.title: Nippon Camera Eye: The Mad Pitching Machine (にっぽんカメラアイ狂気のピッチングマシーン)
programme.desc: The world's fastest pitching machine, throwing at 250 km/h. People fascinated by the madness living inside this machine, which hurls blazing fastballs, keep facing the instant the ball is released and continue to push their own limits.

programme.title: Great Traverse: Mountain Old Road, Salt Road (4) - Long Traverse of the Ina Mountains! (グレートトラバース山岳古道・塩の道(4)伊那山地大縦走!)
programme.desc: [Featuring] Pro adventure racer... Yōki Tanaka

programme.title: Broadchurch: A Town on Edge (6) (ブロードチャーチ殺意の町(6))
programme.desc: A mystery and human drama in which an incident in a small town shakes the daily lives of its residents. Hardy grows more suspicious of Reverend Paul, while Maggie at the newspaper independently investigates Susan.

programme.title: Musée d'Orsay Mini (オルセー美術館ミニ)
programme.desc: Masterpieces from the Musée d'Orsay in 3 minutes. A work that lets you savor Monet and Manet's "touch of the sun." A work that lets you feel the "touch of the moon" in Rousseau, Vuillard, and Moreau. The door to beauty opens here!

programme.title: Let's Go to the Far End! Remote Railway 10-Minute Mini: Madagascar, FCE Railway (1) (行くぞ!最果て!秘境×鉄道10分ミニマダガスカル・FCE鉄道(1))
programme.desc: So much stacking! The banana train races through a village without electricity. A single locomotive on wavy tracks, and even a mysterious rental train appear! Even if it’s super battered, no problem — what is the villagers' ultimate passion for railways?

programme.title: Bullet Train Airport Turnaround Tour: Techo Airport, Cambodia (弾丸!空港トンボがえりツアーカンボジアテチョ空港)
programme.desc: [Narration] Kur之介 Sasaki

programme.title: 8K Time-Lapse Journey: Fukui (8Kタイムラプス紀行~福井~)
programme.desc: An 8K time-lapse travelogue filmed with an 8K digital single-lens reflex camera. Enjoy images of late autumn on Fukui Prefecture's Echizen Coast, as well as footage of Echizen crab being landed. (Broadcast in 2018)

programme.title: Great Nature 10 min. The Mystical, Brilliant Andes - Peru, South America (グレートネイチャー10min.アンデス神秘の極彩大地~南米・ペルー~)
programme.desc: A vivid turquoise river, the Rainbow Mountain where strata in bright red, blue and orange are exposed... Unraveling the mystery of the colorful spectacular scenery spread across a part of the Andes in Peru, South America.

programme.title: Nippon Journey of the Heart: Archive Special (にっぽん縦断こころ旅蔵出しスペシャル)
programme.desc: This week's "Cocoro Tabi" will be "Kura-dashi Special" both at noon (BS only) and at night! This day features the Oita Prefecture journey run by Misako Tanaka in March 2025! Packed with memorable scenes and never-before-seen behind-the-scenes footage!

programme.title: Wild Life: A Great Journey of the Penguin Current from Antarctica to the Equator (ワイルドライフ南極から赤道までペンギン海流大いなる旅)
programme.desc: Around the Humboldt Current in South America, there is a world of penguins astonishingly diverse. Ice-covered lands, storm-lashed remote islands, desert islands. From Antarctica to the equator, travel the far-reaching "penguin current."

programme.title: Poirot (名探偵ポワロ(30))
programme.sub-title: The Mysterious Affair at Hunter's Lodge
programme.desc: Broadcast in 4K, the popular Agatha Christie series "Poirot"! Poirot and Hastings go out hunting. Waiting for them there is a murder case meticulously planned in advance.

programme.title: Frontier: What Is Oriental Medicine? (フロンティア選東洋医学とは何か)
programme.desc: What kind of effects does acupuncture have? How do herbal medicines work? Traditional Eastern medicine, long shrouded in mystery, now faces the latest scientific findings as they reveal its new possibilities.

programme.title: 4K Premium Cafe: Iguazu National Park, the World's Largest Waterfall (4Kプレミアムカフェ世界最大の滝イグアス国立公園)
programme.desc: High-definition special: Journey through the World Natural Heritage sites. The world’s largest waterfall—Iguazu National Park—depicts the wonders of nature with powerful images and sound. (First broadcast: 2003)

programme.title: Birds Living in Spectacular Scenery: Ishigaki Island and Iriomote Island (絶景に生きる野鳥たち石垣島・西表島)
programme.desc: Spectacular views of islands with coral reefs and subtropical forests stretching out before you. A soothing one-hour program introducing in detail the adorable birds encountered on beaches, in dense forests, in sugarcane fields, and more, with beautiful music and drone footage.

programme.title: 8K Experience! 2025 Montreal International Fireworks Competition: GREATSKYART (8K体感!モントリオール国際花火競技大会2025GREATSKYART)
programme.desc: The Montreal International Fireworks Competition held in Canada. In 2025, the Hokkaido fireworks team "GREATSKYART" will compete. Enjoy world-class fireworks in 8K

programme.title: 8K Journey Through European Trams (2) (8Kヨーロッパトラムの旅(2))
programme.desc: A 8K journey by European tram. We bring you vivid 8K images and the immersive feeling of travelling abroad as if you were riding the tram yourself. This time, we travel through Lisbon, Portugal.

programme.title: Cruising from the Sky: Special Edition, Travel to Croatia's Istria Peninsula (空からクルージング特別編クロアチアイストラ半島の旅)
programme.desc: A full aerial tour of Croatia’s Istrian Peninsula, blessed with magnificent nature and historical heritage, before heading to Krk Island. It introduces a village floating in the mist, a World Heritage cathedral, an ancient Roman amphitheater, a medieval town, and more.

programme.title: Cosmic Front ☆ Healing Magic Hour: When the Sky Turns Magical (コズミックフロント☆ヒーリングマジックアワー天空が魔法にかかるとき)
programme.desc: The time when the sky takes on a mysterious hue, as if by magic, is called the "magic hour." We look at the brief time that comes only in the span between morning and evening, wrapped in the finest colors, across Japan and around the world.

programme.title: Beautiful Nature in Japan: A Collection of Images (3) Mountains of Iwate (さわやか自然百景映像集(3)岩手の山々)

This is where Kōbō Daishi Kūkai set out for Tang China, and where Toyotomi Hideyoshi built the huge Nagoya Castle. A land of unchanged daily life and places of prayer... A journey to encounter the distant past.

programme.desc: A journey tracing the history of the small country of Malta floating in the Mediterranean from the sky. Fortresses telling the history of the Knights of St. John, cathedrals, towns that have continued since the era of Islamic rule, and then on to the world before BCE!

programme.title: Strangers from Hell (他人は地獄だPG12)

programme.title: Women in the Mirror (鏡の女たち)

programme.title: Manzai Gang (漫才ギャング)

programme.title: Handsome Suit (ハンサム★スーツ)

programme.title: The Beekeeper (ビーキーパー PG12)

programme.title: Donnie Brasco (フェイク)
programme.desc: ★ 7.5/10 · 1997 — A fine crime drama bringing together J. Depp and A. Pacino. An FBI agent (Depp) sent undercover into the mafia meets a down-and-out mobster (Pacino).

programme.title: The Forest of Shinetsuri (脛擦りの森)

programme.title: Till We Meet Again (くれなずめ)

It depicts the struggle of a genius climber who takes on an unprecedentedly difficult route on the world's highest peak, Everest, and the mountain cameraman who follows him.

programme.title: The Summit: A Chronicle of Mount Tsurugi (劔岳点の記)

programme.title: The Twins Effect (ツインズ・エフェクト)

programme.title: Perfume: Love's Limit Is 12 Hours (パフューム〜恋のリミットは12時間〜)
My Sweet Home (マイ スイート ホーム)
programme.desc: 2026 — The housewife Haruka (Yuriko Ishida), whose children are now independent, lives a rich and peaceful life with her husband. She has friends bound by deep friendship. Their homes and jobs are all different—Tokyo, Hayama, Karuizawa—but now they regularly gather together, sometimes with their partners too. Haruka, Natsuki, Akie. And another friend, Fuyumi, with whom they have grown distant... "Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter" had always been together since their student days. Then, one day, they suddenly receive word of Fuyumi's death. Thinking about Fuyumi, the three reaffirm where they have been, where they are now, and how they want to live from here on as they approach sixty, having lived diligently without ever straying from the rails. "I want to become someone other than myself, even just once." The three remember the wish Fuyumi had voiced while alive. And so they decide to try something silly that might make the Fuyumi in heaven laugh. It was a two-week "trial life" in which they swapped partners.

programme.title: My Sweet Home (マイ スイート ホーム)
programme.desc: 2026 — The housewife Haruka (Yuriko Ishida), whose children are now independent, lives a rich and peaceful life with her husband. She has friends bound by deep friendship. Their homes and jobs are all different—Tokyo, Hayama, Karuizawa—but now they regularly gather together, sometimes with their partners too. Haruka, Natsuki, Akie. And another friend, Fuyumi, with whom they have grown distant... "Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter" had always been together since their student days. Then, one day, they suddenly receive word of Fuyumi's death. Thinking about Fuyumi, the three reaffirm where they have been, where they are now, and how they want to live from here on as they approach sixty, having lived diligently without ever straying from the rails. "I want to become someone other than myself, even just once." The three remember the wish Fuyumi had voiced while alive. And so they decide to try something silly that might make the Fuyumi in heaven laugh. It was a two-week "trial life" in which they swapped partners.

programme.desc: Anpanman is a superhero who dedicates himself to the cause of justice, aiding the plight of unfortunate souls. Anpanman will go anywhere to help anyone in trouble, to drive away villains, and to save people from starvation by allowing them to eat his face. What? Let his face be eaten? No need to worry. His face is made with sweet anpan (bread filled with bean jam), hence the name Anpanman. Anpanman's very life depends on allowing others to eat, and once eaten, Anpanman can restore himself endlessly. He does not look handsome or strong, but he never fears any adventure and is continuously flying to aid the hungry people and the children with difficulties. Anpanman is the hero of the new age, glowing with friendship, endeavour and justice.

programme.title: An-chan (あんちゃん)
programme.desc: Set in a hot spring town, this warm-hearted downtown drama follows the ordinary young man Ittetsu Tanonaka, who used to work in Tokyo as a manager and trainer for a women's pro-wrestling team, as he is suddenly forced to serve as the head priest of a temple after his father's sudden death. He had received basic training to become a priest, but for a young man who had lived freely in the city for nearly 10 years after graduating university, the work is a great burden. Thanks to his late father's personality, in a small town like this, the priest's role was not limited to ceremonies but also included everything from advice on worries to welfare work, serving as a catch-all for all kinds of troubles. Longing for his carefree city life, Ittetsu is torn. With the support and encouragement of his mother and sisters, and the help of old friends, this cheerful human drama depicts his growth into a fully fledged head priest. (26 episodes)

programme.sub-title: Naganegiman and Tekka no Komaki-chan" and more
programme.desc: Anpanman is a superhero who dedicates himself to the cause of justice, aiding the plight of unfortunate souls. Anpanman will go anywhere to help anyone in trouble, to drive away villains, and to save people from starvation by allowing them to eat his face. What? Let his face be eaten? No need to worry. His face is made with sweet anpan (bread filled with bean jam), hence the name Anpanman. Anpanman's very life depends on allowing others to eat, and once eaten, Anpanman can restore himself endlessly. He does not look handsome or strong, but he never fears any adventure and is continuously flying to aid the hungry people and the children with difficulties. Anpanman is the hero of the new age, glowing with friendship, endeavour and justice.

programme.title: Kiss That Kills (トドメの接吻)
An-chan (あんちゃん)
programme.desc: Set in a hot spring town, this warm-hearted downtown drama follows the ordinary young man Ittetsu Tanonaka, who used to work in Tokyo as a manager and trainer for a women's pro-wrestling team, as he is suddenly forced to serve as the head priest of a temple after his father's sudden death. He had received basic training to become a priest, but for a young man who had lived freely in the city for nearly 10 years after graduating university, the work is a great burden. Thanks to his late father's personality, in a small town like this, the priest's role was not limited to ceremonies but also included everything from advice on worries to welfare work, serving as a catch-all for all kinds of troubles. Longing for his carefree city life, Ittetsu is torn. With the support and encouragement of his mother and sisters, and the help of old friends, this cheerful human drama depicts his growth into a fully fledged head priest. (26 episodes)

programme.sub-title: Akachanman and the Giant Lamp" and more
programme.desc: Anpanman is a superhero who dedicates himself to the cause of justice, aiding the plight of unfortunate souls. Anpanman will go anywhere to help anyone in trouble, to drive away villains, and to save people from starvation by allowing them to eat his face. What? Let his face be eaten? No need to worry. His face is made with sweet anpan (bread filled with bean jam), hence the name Anpanman. Anpanman's very life depends on allowing others to eat, and once eaten, Anpanman can restore himself endlessly. He does not look handsome or strong, but he never fears any adventure and is continuously flying to aid the hungry people and the children with difficulties. Anpanman is the hero of the new age, glowing with friendship, endeavour and justice.

programme.title: An-chan (あんちゃん)
programme.desc: Set in a hot spring town, this warm-hearted downtown drama follows the ordinary young man Ittetsu Tanonaka, who used to work in Tokyo as a manager and trainer for a women's pro-wrestling team, as he is suddenly forced to serve as the head priest of a temple after his father's sudden death. He had received basic training to become a priest, but for a young man who had lived freely in the city for nearly 10 years after graduating university, the work is a great burden. Thanks to his late father's personality, in a small town like this, the priest's role was not limited to ceremonies but also included everything from advice on worries to welfare work, serving as a catch-all for all kinds of troubles. Longing for his carefree city life, Ittetsu is torn. With the support and encouragement of his mother and sisters, and the help of old friends, this cheerful human drama depicts his growth into a fully fledged head priest. (26 episodes)

Anpanman (それいけ!アンパンマン)
programme.sub-title: Poppo-chan and Smoky Dog” and more
programme.desc: Anpanman is a superhero who dedicates himself to the cause of justice, aiding the plight of unfortunate souls. Anpanman will go anywhere to help anyone in trouble, to drive away villains, and to save people from starvation by allowing them to eat his face. What? Let his face be eaten? No need to worry. His face is made with sweet anpan (bread filled with bean jam), hence the name Anpanman. Anpanman's very life depends on allowing others to eat, and once eaten, Anpanman can restore himself endlessly. He does not look handsome or strong, but he never fears any adventure and is continuously flying to aid the hungry people and the children with difficulties. Anpanman is the hero of the new age, glowing with friendship, endeavour and justice.

programme.title: Anego (anego[アネゴ])
programme.desc: 2005 — Naoko Noda, who works in a trading company, is called "anego" by her younger co-workers. What is "anego"? It means "older sister," but in this case it is given as a nickname to Naoko because she is like a big sister to her coworkers, who depend on her to give them advice about everything. This drama, depicts realistically how Naoko lives her everyday life, including her love life, the problems she faces, and her uneasiness about the future. --NTV

programme.title: News Reporter Chabo! (事件記者 チャボ!)
programme.desc: 1983 — Ippei Nakayama, nicknamed "Chabo" for his energetic and spirited personality, is a local reporter who moves from his quiet hometown of Matsuyama to the bustling metropolis of Tokyo. He joins the police reporting unit of a major news agency, bringing a fresh and unorthodox perspective to the city's cynical journalism scene. While typical city reporters focus on getting the fastest "scoop" and cold facts, Chabo is a man of deep empathy. He often finds himself getting too involved in the lives of the suspects and victims he covers, looking for the human truth behind every incident. The series beautifully balances comedic moments with the harsh realities of crime reporting, showcasing Chabo's growth as he struggles to maintain his integrity and warmth in the face of big-city challenges.

programme.title: Magical Girl Raising Project: Restart (魔法少女育成計画restart)
programme.desc: 2026 — Once again, sixteen Magical Girls have been assembled for a high-stakes challenge. Every three days, their Magical Phone pulls them into an RPG-like simulation where they have to work together to fight enemies, solve puzzles, and earn Magical Candy to advance. A staggering ten billion yen reward awaits them at the end—but only for the players who land the finishing blow. With such a tantalizing prize on the line, it's only a matter of time before the girls turn on each other—and if their hit points drop to zero, a game over will be the least of their worries...

programme.title: Romelia War Chronicle (ロメリア戦記)
programme.desc: 2026 — Victory over the Demon King should have been Romelia’s triumph. Instead, her fiance, Prince Henri, breaks off their engagement and sends her home in disgrace to a province in ruins. With no aid in sight, Romelia vows to raise an army, rebuild the ruined towns, and restore a struggling kingdom as new conflicts arise. The war may be over, but her story’s just begun.

programme.title: The Detective Is Already Dead (探偵はもう、死んでいる)
programme.desc: ★ 5.7/10 · 2021 — After thwarting a hijacking with beautiful, silver-haired detective Siesta, Kimihiko leads a life of globe-trotting and crime-solving—until Siesta dies. A year later, a new case will open old wounds as it threads murder, conspiracy, and his dead partner!

programme.title: Sasaki and Peeps (佐々木とピーちゃん)
programme.desc: ★ 7.0/10 · 2024 — Sasaki is a middle-aged office worker living in Japan. Feeling drained by the vapid corporate world, he heads to the pet shop in search of a new companion. There he finds an adorable bird named Peeps and takes him home. But Sasaki quickly learns that Peeps isn’t your average bird…he’s a powerful mage from another world! Together, they embark on a magical adventure filled with swords and sorcery.

programme.title: Mission: Yozakura Family (夜桜さんちの大作戦)
programme.desc: ★ 7.5/10 · 2024 — Taiyo Asano has been on his own ever since his parents died and the only one who seems to care for him is his childhood friend and classmate, Mutsumi Yozakura. But Mutsumi has a secret—she is the head of a family of spies! And on top of that, her brother Kyoichiro is dangerously protective of her! To stop Kyoichiro from killing him, Taiyo and Mutsumi must take the ultimate leap—marriage! Because in the Yozakura family, family cannot kill family.

programme.title: Kusunoki's House with a God's Garden (神の庭付き楠木邸)
programme.desc: 2026 — Minato Kusunoki is assigned to manage his family’s haunted, abandoned countryside estate. However, thanks to his overwhelming spiritual power, Minato accidentally purifies the entire place, turning the once-cursed property into a peaceful haven for wandering gods and deities! As Minato settles in, he finds himself surrounded by quirky divine neighbors and the lively chaos of life among the gods.

programme.title: From Far Away (彼方から)
programme.desc: 2026 — Noriko is an ordinary high school student, until an explosion pulls her into a world of magic where no one speaks her language. Completely lost, Noriko is rescued by Izark, a shunned swordsman determined to kill the Awakening: a prophesied figure said to control the Sky Demon. As Izark and Noriko bond, he realizes she may be the very person he’s hunting.

programme.title: Bodacious Space Pirates (モーレツ宇宙海賊)
programme.desc: ★ 6.4/10 · 2012 — Marika is a high school student living on a planet known as Uminoakeboshi. One day she finds out that her deceased father was the captain of the space pirate ship called the "Bentenmaru". More importantly, the one to inherit the captain's title has to be a direct descendant—meaning that Marika is now the captain of the ship.

programme.title: RahXephon (ラーゼフォン)
programme.desc: ★ 7.3/10 · 2002 — Ayato Kamina, a 17-year-old high school student, lives in Tokyo Jupiter oblivious to the world around him, having been raised to believe that the rest of civilization has been destroyed; but everything changes when a mysterious alien civilization invades his home.

programme.title: Mizuiro Jidai (水色時代)
programme.desc: 1996 — Yuuko, a shy girl in Middle School, has feelings for her friend who lives next door. But then she finds out her best friend also likes him too.

programme.title: Sgt. Frog (ケロロ軍曹)
programme.desc: ★ 7.0/10 · 2004 — Alien frogs come to take over the planet & get into all kinds of trouble while living under the roof of a small family.

programme.title: Lent Magic Is Forced Collected with Revolving Payments (貸した魔力は【リボ払い】で強制徴収)
programme.desc: 2026 — In a world where magical Gifts determine your destiny, Lent’s rare ability lets him lend his magic points to others. He forms an adventuring party called the Skypiercers with his friends, helping them become powerful heroes, only to be later cast aside as dead weight. Furious, Lent awakens the true power of his Gift: Forced Collection, the power to repossess magic. His revenge starts now.

programme.title: #Looking for Zombies (#ゾンビさがしてます)
programme.desc: 2026 — It may be a ruined city ravaged by zombies, but to Aki and her friends, it's amazing! Having grown up only hearing stories of the old world and the mysterious outbreak that wiped out humanity, she sets off with her childhood friends in search of her missing father. Things quickly become a fight for survival outside the safety of their small village, yet they've never felt more alive.

programme.title: Hello, I Am a Witch Who Was Asked to Make a Love Potion (どうも、好きな人に惚れ薬を依頼された魔女です)
programme.desc: 2026 — Rose, a lone witch who lives quietly by the lake, is asked by the knight she secretly loves to brew a love potion—for someone else. Though heartbroken, she cannot refuse him, choosing instead to treasure the fleeting time they spend together gathering ingredients. And as the days quietly slip by, Rose finds herself clinging to each shared moment, dreading the day the potion is finally complete.

programme.title: A Reincarnated Great Saint Hides That She Is a Saint (転生した大聖女は、聖女であることをひた隠す)
programme.desc: 2026 — Fia always dreamed of being a great knight, despite her lack of talent as a swordswoman. Then, a brush with death in battle awakens memories of her past life as the legendary Saint who defeated the Demon King. Her powers return, but so do the enemies who killed her once before. Fia vows to conceal her true identity to survive. But how can a knight resist using her powers to help those in need?

programme.title: Overgeared (テムパル〜アイテムの力〜)
programme.desc: 2026 — Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

programme.title: Magical★Explorer (マジカル★エクスプローラー)
programme.desc: 2026 — Reborn in his favorite bishojo game, Kousuke gets the worst role possible: the forgettable sidekick. But armed with his knowledge of the game and this world’s largest mana pool, he might even surpass the hero! Now Kousuke must rewrite his fate and battle his way toward the heroines’ happy endings!

programme.title: Vertex Force (バーテックスフォース)
programme.desc: 2026 — Akira Todo has always lived in the shadow of his sister, Haruka, who secretly wields their father’s mysterious “Engine.” But when a mysterious enemy comes for his family, Akira is forced into a battle that threatens the entire world. He may have inherited none of his father’s power, but now he must find a way to fight back. Or risk losing everything he cares about.

Following “Port Town Walks in Hokkaido with Rui Yoshida ,” this series will take you to every corner of Hokkaido, from mountain towns surrounded by nature to inland towns and remote islands, accompanied by female announcers from HBC. They will seek out the best restaurants frequented by locals, taste fresh seafood from the mountains and the sea, and savor delicious sake. They also have a lot of fun with store owners and regular customers! In search of Hokkaido's hidden gems, seasonal delicacies, sake, and encounters, Rui Yoshida's wandering journey continues.

programme.title: The Legend of Shen Li (中国ドラマ「与鳳行」ノーカット字幕版)
programme.desc: ★ 8.4/10 · 2024 — The ancient gods died, and there is only one last god in the world - Xingzhi. Rumor has it that this God of Action has lived alone in the heavens for tens of thousands of years, ruthless and lustless. In the battle of the immortals and demons, he turned the tide by himself, and since then, Du Men has been swept away, and his traces are hard to find. Hundreds of years are just a click away. As the queen who was born with a pearl in the devil world, Shen Li's life was bright and dazzling. But on the occasion of her thousand-year-old birthday, the claws of political marriage were scratching their heads. On the way to escape from the marriage, Shen Li was beaten back to the original form of a phoenix and fell to the world with injuries. When she was seriously injured and comatose, the mortal hawker treated her as a fat chicken, plucked all the hair from her body, and locked her in a cage for sale. The fate of the two is tightly linked by a seemingly casual transaction.

Mito Komon, Part 1 (水戸黄門・第1部) (New)
programme.desc: 1969 — Tokugawa Mitsukuni (Eijiro Tono) was living in retirement at Nishiyamaso in Hitachi Province, working the fields while compiling the Dai Nihonshi and teaching nearby children to read and write. Mito retainers Sasaki Sukesaburo (Sugitaro Sugi) and Atsumi Kakunoshin (Masashi Yokouchi) were ordered by the domain to assist Mitsukuni, but they were starting to feel restless from the overly peaceful days. One day, the father of Kakunoshin’s betrothed, Miyuki, committed seppuku in front of the gate of the Mito clan elder’s residence. Something serious seems to be hidden behind the incident. At the same time, Mitsukuni received a document from the righteous thief Kazaguruma no Yajiro (Ichiro Nakatani). It was a secret letter addressed to Mito’s Edo elder, Fujii Montayu, from senior councilor Yanagisawa Yoshiyasu, Mitsukuni’s adversary. It appears that Yoshiyasu and Montayu are conspiring with each other to seize control of both the shogunate and the Mito domain. And so Mitsukuni, Sukesaburo, and Kakunoshin set off from Mito under the pretense of being a retired owner of a Chichibu crepe dealer and his servant...

programme.title: The Legend of Shen Li (中国ドラマ「与鳳行」ノーカット字幕版)
programme.desc: ★ 8.4/10 · 2024 — The ancient gods died, and there is only one last god in the world - Xingzhi. Rumor has it that this God of Action has lived alone in the heavens for tens of thousands of years, ruthless and lustless. In the battle of the immortals and demons, he turned the tide by himself, and since then, Du Men has been swept away, and his traces are hard to find. Hundreds of years are just a click away. As the queen who was born with a pearl in the devil world, Shen Li's life was bright and dazzling. But on the occasion of her thousand-year-old birthday, the claws of political marriage were scratching their heads. On the way to escape from the marriage, Shen Li was beaten back to the original form of a phoenix and fell to the world with injuries. When she was seriously injured and comatose, the mortal hawker treated her as a fat chicken, plucked all the hair from her body, and locked her in a cage for sale. The fate of the two is tightly linked by a seemingly casual transaction.

programme.title: Mito Komon, Part 1 (水戸黄門・第1部)
programme.desc: 1969 — Tokugawa Mitsukuni (Eijiro Tono) was living in retirement at Nishiyamaso in Hitachi Province, working the fields while compiling the Dai Nihonshi and teaching nearby children to read and write. Mito retainers Sasaki Sukesaburo (Sugitaro Sugi) and Atsumi Kakunoshin (Masashi Yokouchi) were ordered by the domain to assist Mitsukuni, but they were starting to feel restless from the overly peaceful days. One day, the father of Kakunoshin’s betrothed, Miyuki, committed seppuku in front of the gate of the Mito clan elder’s residence. Something serious seems to be hidden behind the incident. At the same time, Mitsukuni received a document from the righteous thief Kazaguruma no Yajiro (Ichiro Nakatani). It was a secret letter addressed to Mito’s Edo elder, Fujii Montayu, from senior councilor Yanagisawa Yoshiyasu, Mitsukuni’s adversary. It appears that Yoshiyasu and Montayu are conspiring with each other to seize control of both the shogunate and the Mito domain. And so Mitsukuni, Sukesaburo, and Kakunoshin set off from Mito under the pretense of being a retired owner of a Chichibu crepe dealer and his servant...

programme.desc: ★ 8.4/10 · 2024 — The ancient gods died, and there is only one last god in the world - Xingzhi. Rumor has it that this God of Action has lived alone in the heavens for tens of thousands of years, ruthless and lustless. In the battle of the immortals and demons, he turned the tide by himself, and since then, Du Men has been swept away, and his traces are hard to find. Hundreds of years are just a click away. As the queen who was born with a pearl in the devil world, Shen Li's life was bright and dazzling. But on the occasion of her thousand-year-old birthday, the claws of political marriage were scratching their heads. On the way to escape from the marriage, Shen Li was beaten back to the original form of a phoenix and fell to the world with injuries. When she was seriously injured and comatose, the mortal hawker treated her as a fat chicken, plucked all the hair from her body, and locked her in a cage for sale. The fate of the two is tightly linked by a seemingly casual transaction.

At the same time, Mitsukuni received a document from the righteous thief Kazaguruma no Yajiro (Ichiro Nakatani). It was a secret letter addressed to Mito’s Edo elder, Fujii Montayu, from senior councilor Yanagisawa Yoshiyasu, Mitsukuni’s adversary. It appears that Yoshiyasu and Montayu are conspiring with each other to seize control of both the shogunate and the Mito domain. And so Mitsukuni, Sukesaburo, and Kakunoshin set off from Mito under the pretense of being a retired owner of a Chichibu crepe dealer and his servant...
