programme.desc: ★ 8.4/10 · 2024 — The ancient gods died, and there is only one last god in the world - Xingzhi. Rumor has it that this God of Action has lived alone in the heavens for tens of thousands of years, ruthless and lustless. In the battle of the immortals and demons, he turned the tide by himself, and since then, Du Men has been swept away, and his traces are hard to find. Hundreds of years are just a click away. As the queen who was born with a pearl in the devil world, Shen Li's life was bright and dazzling. But on the occasion of her thousand-year-old birthday, the claws of political marriage were scratching their heads. On the way to escape from the marriage, Shen Li was beaten back to the original form of a phoenix and fell to the world with injuries. When she was seriously injured and comatose, the mortal hawker treated her as a fat chicken, plucked all the hair from her body, and locked her in a cage for sale. The fate of the two is tightly linked by a seemingly casual transaction.

Tokuda Detective Series (徳田刑事シリーズ)
programme.desc: 1993 — Detective Nakao (Matsumura Yuki) lost his sister to a rape-murder five years ago and has lived only to find the culprit and kill him with his own hands. Together with his senior, Detective Tokuda (Tamura Takahiro), he arrests the culprit one minute before the statute of limitations expires... A serious drama based on a work by Hisayuki Nishimura, which deftly portrays the trick behind the statute of limitations. The obsession of the detective whose sister was killed, and the psychology of the veteran detective trying to solve the case calmly, intertwine brilliantly, while violence and deduction drive the drama forward with force. Young detective Nakao, assigned to the First Investigation Division, had his sister murdered 15 years earlier. To veteran detective Tokuda, who knew Nakao back then saying, "I'll kill the culprit with my own hands," their meeting can be seen as fateful. But there is only one week left before that case, too, reaches its statute of limitations. Nakao, who has lived only to kill his sister's murderer, has been whispered about as a "violent detective" who bares his hatred toward criminals. Then a report comes in that the fingerprints of a man named Harada, who caused a traffic accident, match those of the culprit from 15 years ago, and Nakao takes leave and heads to Kyushu.

Quiz Derby (クイズダービー)
programme.desc: A quiz show that emphasizes entertainment in a horse-race format, in which contestants are likened to racing horses and bet their own points, using reasoning and intuition, on the contestant most likely to get the answer right. The questions vary widely each time, from general knowledge to jokes packed with gags. Three teams of two contestants each place bets in units of at least 100 points out of their 3,000 points, referring to the arbitrarily assigned odds the host gives to the five contestants. The outcome depends on whether to steadily bet on Hara Taira or the "queen of three choices" Keiko Takeshita, whose odds are low but whose accuracy is high, or to go for a huge payoff by betting on answerers like Dai Kitano or Miyuki Imori, whose odds are high but whose accuracy is not so great. The winner is not known until the very end, and contestants receive prize money equal to their score.

programme.title: Quiz Derby (クイズダービー)
programme.desc: A quiz show that emphasizes entertainment in a horse-race format, in which contestants are likened to racing horses and bet their own points, using reasoning and intuition, on the contestant most likely to get the answer right. The questions vary widely each time, from general knowledge to jokes packed with gags. Three teams of two contestants each place bets in units of at least 100 points out of their 3,000 points, referring to the arbitrarily assigned odds the host gives to the five contestants. The outcome depends on whether to steadily bet on Hara Taira or the "queen of three choices" Keiko Takeshita, whose odds are low but whose accuracy is high, or to go for a huge payoff by betting on answerers like Dai Kitano or Miyuki Imori, whose odds are high but whose accuracy is not so great. The winner is not known until the very end, and contestants receive prize money equal to their score.

programme.title: Dangerous Venus (危険なビーナス) (New)
programme.desc: 2020 — Hakuro is single and works as a veterinarian. His father died when Hakuro was a child and his mother later remarried into the wealthy Yagami family. Although Hakuro was brought into the Yagami family through his mother's marriage, he does not feel like part of the Yagami family. Especially, when compared to his younger step-brother who possesses the same blood as his family. After the death of Hakuro's mother, Hakuro dropped Yagami from his name and broke off relations with that family. Hakuro has a strong sense of justice and sincerity in his actions. He is very susceptible to beautiful women. One day, he meets a woman. The woman introduces herself as the wife of his stepbrother and informs him that his stepbrother is missing. As Hakuro and the woman trace his stepbrother's whereabouts, Hakuro becomes involved in the Yagami family's fight over a three billion yen inheritance.

programme.title: Dangerous Venus (危険なビーナス)
programme.desc: 2020 — Hakuro is single and works as a veterinarian. His father died when Hakuro was a child and his mother later remarried into the wealthy Yagami family. Although Hakuro was brought into the Yagami family through his mother's marriage, he does not feel like part of the Yagami family. Especially, when compared to his younger step-brother who possesses the same blood as his family. After the death of Hakuro's mother, Hakuro dropped Yagami from his name and broke off relations with that family. Hakuro has a strong sense of justice and sincerity in his actions. He is very susceptible to beautiful women. One day, he meets a woman. The woman introduces herself as the wife of his stepbrother and informs him that his stepbrother is missing. As Hakuro and the woman trace his stepbrother's whereabouts, Hakuro becomes involved in the Yagami family's fight over a three billion yen inheritance.

programme.title: The Bride of the Century (韓国ドラマ「百年の花嫁」ノーカット字幕版)
Quiz Derby (クイズダービー)
programme.desc: A quiz show that emphasizes entertainment in a horse-race format, in which contestants are likened to racing horses and bet their own points, using reasoning and intuition, on the contestant most likely to get the answer right. The questions vary widely each time, from general knowledge to jokes packed with gags. Three teams of two contestants each place bets in units of at least 100 points out of their 3,000 points, referring to the arbitrarily assigned odds the host gives to the five contestants. The outcome depends on whether to steadily bet on Hara Taira or the "queen of three choices" Keiko Takeshita, whose odds are low but whose accuracy is high, or to go for a huge payoff by betting on answerers like Dai Kitano or Miyuki Imori, whose odds are high but whose accuracy is not so great. The winner is not known until the very end, and contestants receive prize money equal to their score.

programme.title: Aibou (相棒)
programme.sub-title: The Cassiopeia sleeper train murder case
programme.desc: ★ 7.5/10 · 2002 — Detective Ukyo Sugishita confronts crime on the basis of his own convictions. He has a partner that works for him in the Special Task Unit. For the first 7 seasons, Ukyo’s first partner is Kaoru Kameyama. He is a good-natured, hot-tempered, straightforward and somewhat scattered detective. Beginning in Season 8, Takeru Kanbe replaces Kameyama. Contrary to his predecessor, Takeru is a lanky, cool, conceited and confident detective. From Season 11 to Season 13, Ukyo’s partner is a young detective Toru Kai. Toru is a son of Deputy Director-General of The National Police Agency. But he became a detective by his own effort. And starting with Season 14, Ukyo’s current partner is Wataru Kaburagi, an elite bureaucrat who came to the Metropolitan Police Department on temporary assignment. As the first partner without any career of a police officer, he will face challenging cases together with Ukyo.

programme.title: Sumika Sumire: 45 Years Old, Rejuvenated Woman (スミカスミレ 45歳若返った女) (New)
programme.desc: 2016 — Kisaragi Sumi is a 20-year-old university student. But do not be surprised that she is a 65-year-old inside. Under pressure to help out with the family business from a young age, she could not have a youth. Even afterwards, she devoted her entire life to taking care of first her grandmother and then her father and mother. Sumi finds herself turning 65 without ever having had a boyfriend. She takes a little pride in having lived with integrity. But after her mother passes away, she has the sudden thought of regaining her youth once more and making a fresh start in life. A miracle happens to her. One day when Sumi wakes up, she has the appearance of a 20-year-old. Despite being bewildered by this unbelievable reality, she introduces herself as Sumire and gets another try at youth.

Furious, Lent awakens the true power of his Gift: Forced Collection, the power to repossess magic. His revenge starts now.

Perman (パーマン)
programme.desc: 1983 — Mitsuo encountered Superman, an alien who is a part of a federation that tries to maintain peace in the galaxy. He then received a helmet (that also serves as a mask) that gives superhuman strength, a cape that enables the wearer to fly, and a badge that allows him to breathe underwater and communicate with his fellow comrades whom he met soon after he utilized these gifts. Superman made it clear to all Permans that their identity must be kept a secret or their brain will be destroyed should it ever be revealed and they are given a special doppelganger robot that can replace them while they are away to achieve this feat, although it is not entirely foolproof nor is it free from potential problems. These equipments then allowed them to be young Permans who try to maintain peace and help the people who are in need.

programme.title: Aibou (相棒)
programme.desc: ★ 7.5/10 · 2002 — Detective Ukyo Sugishita confronts crime on the basis of his own convictions. He has a partner that works for him in the Special Task Unit. For the first 7 seasons, Ukyo’s first partner is Kaoru Kameyama. He is a good-natured, hot-tempered, straightforward and somewhat scattered detective. Beginning in Season 8, Takeru Kanbe replaces Kameyama. Contrary to his predecessor, Takeru is a lanky, cool, conceited and confident detective. From Season 11 to Season 13, Ukyo’s partner is a young detective Toru Kai. Toru is a son of Deputy Director-General of The National Police Agency. But he became a detective by his own effort. And starting with Season 14, Ukyo’s current partner is Wataru Kaburagi, an elite bureaucrat who came to the Metropolitan Police Department on temporary assignment. As the first partner without any career of a police officer, he will face challenging cases together with Ukyo.

Hot Stove League (ストーブリーグ) (New)
programme.desc: 2026 — The professional baseball team “Dreams” has long been stuck in last place. Factional disputes within the team, players repeatedly making defensive errors—the organization is on the verge of collapse. Entrusted with rebuilding the Dreams is Sakurazaki Jun, a general manager with no experience playing baseball. Although he lacks competitive experience, he is known as a “championship contractor” who has led multiple sports teams to victory. In order to address the root of the problems, Sakurazaki clashes with players and front office staff while introducing a series of unconventional reforms that defy common sense. And the first decision he makes is trading the star player, who is considered the symbol of the franchise. What is victory? What is a team? Not only the players, but also the club staff are drawn into confronting these questions.

programme.desc: ★ 7.7/10 · 2012 — Daimon Michiko is a 37-year-old freelance surgeon who is part of a questionable “doctor placement service” that has her wander from hospital to hospital. The harsh environment at the hospitals led many doctors to retire from their positions, forcing hospitals to make use of said program to fill the empty spots at least temporary. However, Michiko doesn’t look like a doctor at all with her flashy clothes and eccentric attitude. In the first episode she raises objections to a certain operation which is planned to be done by the head of a hospital who hasn’t performed an operation for a very long time. This causes Michiko to incur odium at the hospital, however, everyone becomes frozen when Michiko points out the outdated skills of the director. She also holds a scrupulous compliance when it comes to her working hours, never does any unnecessary chores that don’t require a medical license, and couldn’t care less about the power struggles within the hospitals. Nobody knows how she acquired such a top-level skill that allows her to claim exorbitant sums as reward, but her private life is an even greater mystery to everyone around her. Tanaka plays a rookie surgeon, Uchida an anesthetist, Kishibe the head of the placement service, and Ito the head of the surgical department of this institution.

Aibou (相棒)
programme.desc: ★ 7.5/10 · 2002 — Detective Ukyo Sugishita confronts crime on the basis of his own convictions. He has a partner that works for him in the Special Task Unit. For the first 7 seasons, Ukyo’s first partner is Kaoru Kameyama. He is a good-natured, hot-tempered, straightforward and somewhat scattered detective. Beginning in Season 8, Takeru Kanbe replaces Kameyama. Contrary to his predecessor, Takeru is a lanky, cool, conceited and confident detective. From Season 11 to Season 13, Ukyo’s partner is a young detective Toru Kai. Toru is a son of Deputy Director-General of The National Police Agency. But he became a detective by his own effort. And starting with Season 14, Ukyo’s current partner is Wataru Kaburagi, an elite bureaucrat who came to the Metropolitan Police Department on temporary assignment. As the first partner without any career of a police officer, he will face challenging cases together with Ukyo.

programme.title: Doctor-X: Surgeon Michiko Daimon (2012) (ドクターX 〜外科医・大門未知子〜(2012))
programme.desc: ★ 7.7/10 · 2012 — Daimon Michiko is a 37-year-old freelance surgeon who is part of a questionable “doctor placement service” that has her wander from hospital to hospital. The harsh environment at the hospitals led many doctors to retire from their positions, forcing hospitals to make use of said program to fill the empty spots at least temporary. However, Michiko doesn’t look like a doctor at all with her flashy clothes and eccentric attitude. In the first episode she raises objections to a certain operation which is planned to be done by the head of a hospital who hasn’t performed an operation for a very long time. This causes Michiko to incur odium at the hospital, however, everyone becomes frozen when Michiko points out the outdated skills of the director. She also holds a scrupulous compliance when it comes to her working hours, never does any unnecessary chores that don’t require a medical license, and couldn’t care less about the power struggles within the hospitals. Nobody knows how she acquired such a top-level skill that allows her to claim exorbitant sums as reward, but her private life is an even greater mystery to everyone around her. Tanaka plays a rookie surgeon, Uchida an anesthetist, Kishibe the head of the placement service, and Ito the head of the surgical department of this institution.

Hot Stove League (ストーブリーグ)
programme.desc: 2026 — The professional baseball team “Dreams” has long been stuck in last place. Factional disputes within the team, players repeatedly making defensive errors—the organization is on the verge of collapse. Entrusted with rebuilding the Dreams is Sakurazaki Jun, a general manager with no experience playing baseball. Although he lacks competitive experience, he is known as a “championship contractor” who has led multiple sports teams to victory. In order to address the root of the problems, Sakurazaki clashes with players and front office staff while introducing a series of unconventional reforms that defy common sense. And the first decision he makes is trading the star player, who is considered the symbol of the franchise. What is victory? What is a team? Not only the players, but also the club staff are drawn into confronting these questions.

programme.title: The Woman of S.R.I. (2024) (科捜研の女(2024))
Aibou (相棒)
programme.desc: ★ 7.5/10 · 2002 — Detective Ukyo Sugishita confronts crime on the basis of his own convictions. He has a partner that works for him in the Special Task Unit. For the first 7 seasons, Ukyo’s first partner is Kaoru Kameyama. He is a good-natured, hot-tempered, straightforward and somewhat scattered detective. Beginning in Season 8, Takeru Kanbe replaces Kameyama. Contrary to his predecessor, Takeru is a lanky, cool, conceited and confident detective. From Season 11 to Season 13, Ukyo’s partner is a young detective Toru Kai. Toru is a son of Deputy Director-General of The National Police Agency. But he became a detective by his own effort. And starting with Season 14, Ukyo’s current partner is Wataru Kaburagi, an elite bureaucrat who came to the Metropolitan Police Department on temporary assignment. As the first partner without any career of a police officer, he will face challenging cases together with Ukyo.

programme.title: Doctor-X: Surgeon Michiko Daimon (2012) (ドクターX 〜外科医・大門未知子〜(2012))
programme.desc: ★ 7.7/10 · 2012 — Daimon Michiko is a 37-year-old freelance surgeon who is part of a questionable “doctor placement service” that has her wander from hospital to hospital. The harsh environment at the hospitals led many doctors to retire from their positions, forcing hospitals to make use of said program to fill the empty spots at least temporary. However, Michiko doesn’t look like a doctor at all with her flashy clothes and eccentric attitude. In the first episode she raises objections to a certain operation which is planned to be done by the head of a hospital who hasn’t performed an operation for a very long time. This causes Michiko to incur odium at the hospital, however, everyone becomes frozen when Michiko points out the outdated skills of the director. She also holds a scrupulous compliance when it comes to her working hours, never does any unnecessary chores that don’t require a medical license, and couldn’t care less about the power struggles within the hospitals. Nobody knows how she acquired such a top-level skill that allows her to claim exorbitant sums as reward, but her private life is an even greater mystery to everyone around her. Tanaka plays a rookie surgeon, Uchida an anesthetist, Kishibe the head of the placement service, and Ito the head of the surgical department of this institution.

One day, while eating barbecued beef, she realizes that her boyfriend, Yuki, will become bald and fat 20 years down the line. She becomes discouraged with the idea that she may end up living her life with Yuki, especially after attending a party with some former classmates who she finds will turn into very handsome men.

Discovering Houses with Atsushi Watanabe (渡辺篤史の建もの探訪)
programme.desc: 1989 — "Watanabe Atsushi no Tatemono Tanko" began in spring 1989 as a travel program visiting famous buildings all over Japan, starting in Okinawa and heading north in step with the cherry blossom front. In other words, it was supposed to end after three months... but it became popular, and before long it had become one of Japan's longest-running programs. Its coverage gradually shifted from public buildings to homes, and today it is a program devoted to houses. And so, looking for wonderful homes, Atsushi Watanabe's "journey" continues today.

In steps a beautiful female doctor who tries to shield him from the cruel reality of his uniqueness.

Discovering Houses with Atsushi Watanabe (渡辺篤史の建もの探訪)
programme.desc: 1989 — "Watanabe Atsushi no Tatemono Tanko" began in spring 1989 as a travel program visiting famous buildings all over Japan, starting in Okinawa and heading north in step with the cherry blossom front. In other words, it was supposed to end after three months... but it became popular, and before long it had become one of Japan's longest-running programs. Its coverage gradually shifted from public buildings to homes, and today it is a program devoted to houses. And so, looking for wonderful homes, Atsushi Watanabe's "journey" continues today.

Metropolitan Police Department: First Investigative Division (警視庁・捜査一課長)
programme.desc: 2016 — The First Investigative Division is the star unit of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department. Jun'ichi Ōiwa, the head of the division, leads around 400 elite detectives. He has an extremely heavy responsibility: attends initial investigations at the scenes of all brutal crimes that occur within the metropolis, decides on the course of action of the investigations at the same time as he directs many investigation task forces and gets into investigations himself at the critical phase. However, Ōiwa is definitely not a superman. Amid his suffering, Ōiwa overcomes this grave responsibility and is quite simply a "life-size hero" and "ideal boss" to his subordinates.

programme.desc: 2010 — Housewife Miyazawa Tomomi, her husband out of a job, loses her treasured home as her family is forced to do with less during the recession. Her one ray of sunshine is her upcoming middle school class reunion, where she hopes to meet old friends as well as old flames. The class reunion, however, turns out to be more of turning point not only for her but for the others as well. Just how will these four people's lives change after their class reunion...

programme.title: Unmet: A Neurosurgeon's Diary (アンメット −ある脳外科医の日記−)
programme.desc: 2024 — Kawauchi Miyabi was once a promising neurosurgeon, but an accident caused damage to Miyabi's brain. She is unable to remember the past 2 years of her life and she will forget everything that happened today when she wakes up the next day. She has all but given up on becoming a doctor and works as an assistant nurse. One day, Neurosurgeon Sanpei Tomoharu appears in front of her. He is known as an eccentric person. Sanpei Tomoharu guides Kawauchi Miyabi at his own pace, regardless of her will. This actually helps Kawauchi Miyabi as a doctor and a patient. The mystery hidden in her missing memories is gradually revealed, which contains a secret.

Korean Drama: Wind and Cloud and Rain (韓国ドラマ「風と雲と雨」)
programme.desc: 2020 — In the late 19th century, the Joseon Dynasty is in peril because the Kim Family abuses power. The king's power has already weakened, and the people are suffering famine and hardship. Choi Chon-joong is Joseon's best fortune teller and physiognomist, who lost people he loves to Kim Family. He swore to overthrow the Kims and reform the country. He read the hunger to power in Lee Ha-eung, a humble-looking member of the royal family, and decides to help him to set his son on the throne. Meanwhile, the Kims also find the heir to the throne, using Bong-ryun's special gift. Bong-ryun, the daughter of the current king, has the power of psychometry. While the royals and powerful politicians are making and breaking alliances to get ahold of the thrones, Chon-joong focuses on kingmaking that can bring Chosun a new era.

He swore to overthrow the Kims and reform the country. He read the hunger to power in Lee Ha-eung, a humble-looking member of the royal family, and decides to help him to set his son on the throne. Meanwhile, the Kims also find the heir to the throne, using Bong-ryun's special gift. Bong-ryun, the daughter of the current king, has the power of psychometry. While the royals and powerful politicians are making and breaking alliances to get ahold of the thrones, Chon-joong focuses on kingmaking that can bring Chosun a new era.

programme.title: Unmet: A Neurosurgeon's Diary (アンメット −ある脳外科医の日記−)
programme.desc: 2024 — Kawauchi Miyabi was once a promising neurosurgeon, but an accident caused damage to Miyabi's brain. She is unable to remember the past 2 years of her life and she will forget everything that happened today when she wakes up the next day. She has all but given up on becoming a doctor and works as an assistant nurse. One day, Neurosurgeon Sanpei Tomoharu appears in front of her. He is known as an eccentric person. Sanpei Tomoharu guides Kawauchi Miyabi at his own pace, regardless of her will. This actually helps Kawauchi Miyabi as a doctor and a patient. The mystery hidden in her missing memories is gradually revealed, which contains a secret.

Korean Drama: Wind and Cloud and Rain (韓国ドラマ「風と雲と雨」)
programme.desc: 2020 — In the late 19th century, the Joseon Dynasty is in peril because the Kim Family abuses power. The king's power has already weakened, and the people are suffering famine and hardship. Choi Chon-joong is Joseon's best fortune teller and physiognomist, who lost people he loves to Kim Family. He swore to overthrow the Kims and reform the country. He read the hunger to power in Lee Ha-eung, a humble-looking member of the royal family, and decides to help him to set his son on the throne. Meanwhile, the Kims also find the heir to the throne, using Bong-ryun's special gift. Bong-ryun, the daughter of the current king, has the power of psychometry. While the royals and powerful politicians are making and breaking alliances to get ahold of the thrones, Chon-joong focuses on kingmaking that can bring Chosun a new era.

Spice Traveler (スパイストラベラー)
programme.desc: 2020 — Curry is now a national dish in Japan. In recent years, more and more original curry specialty shops, with a strong focus on spices, have been opening. The new format of shared-space curry shops has also sparked a movement, and Japanese curry continues to evolve in its own unique way. The program introduces a number of famous restaurants leading the recent curry boom. We hear about their commitment to spices, whose possible combinations are said to be endless, the challenges they face, and the appeal of their curry. In the hands-on segment, the two MCs learn spice dishes from a professional chef and serve them to the guests. Even spices that seem difficult to use are explained in detail. Each dish is crafted so it can be recreated at home. The MCs are Makoto Sakurai (Dragon Ash) and Cente Chihiro Chittiii (BiSH), both known as some of the biggest curry lovers in the music industry. Guiding the restaurant introductions is AKINO LEE, aka Curry Ojisan (^o^)/, a true curry fanatic who eats nothing but curry for all three meals, 365 days a year. The chef teaching the two is Shingo Yabu of Spice Drunker Yabuya, which was selected as a Tabelog Top 100 restaurant in just five months of business. This new program, "Spice Traveler," brings you a guest each episode. Each distinctive member is itself a kind of "spice." How they blend together is anyone’s guess. Please look forward to "Spice Traveler," an ultra-authentic spice exploration program traveling through the world of spices!

programme.desc: 1982 — This is the first directorial work by the newcomer Kobayashi, who made his debut the same year in a supporting dual role in Umbrella. However, after filming several indoor scenes, production was halted due to various circumstances, and the film was never released publicly, making it a lost work. It has been skillfully edited by Mr. Mouri into a coherent piece. It allows us to glimpse the origins of Kobayashi’s lifelong study of romance films. One is captivated by its exquisite lighting and camera work.

programme.title: Team Medical Dragon (医龍 Team Medical Dragon)
programme.sub-title: Kenji Sakaguchi stars as a genius cardiovascular surgeon.
programme.desc: 2006 — Ryutaro Asada was the chief surgeon of Team Medical Dragon, a globally active emergency medical care team that worked in refugee camps. After his return to Japan, this amazingly talented surgeon starts work at a university hospital, where he uncovers one case of corruption after another and takes on a lot of powerful contenders in this heroic drama. The struggles between the hospital and the patients, the infighting among the hospital staff, and the patients who get involved in those struggles are all depicted in a realistic manner in a drama that has an overwhelming feeling of speed. Here’s a human drama depicting a thrilling battle between life and death, a totally new, outstanding form of entertainment.

programme.title: We’re Starting Our Tetsuinchō (私たち鉄印帳はじめます)
programme.desc: 2021 — Set off on a free and easy trip to collect "train stamps" on local railway lines across Japan! Like collecting goshuin, "train stamps" can be collected on 40 local railway companies nationwide. This began through cooperation between member railway companies and related firms of the Third-Sector Railway Council, with the aim of promoting local areas along regional railway lines. In this program..., two actresses take a carefree trip to collect train stamps, accompanied by beautiful images shot with a single-lens camera and carefully selected music. The railway version of a goshuincho is the "train stamp book." Sisters Maryjun Takahashi and Yuu return to their hometown in Shiga in search of train stamps. Starting from Lake Biwa, the largest lake in Japan, they take Keihan Electric Railway from the nostalgic Ishiba Station to Kibukawa Station. They transfer to the Shigaraki Kogen Railway they came for, aiming for Shigaraki Station, famous for tanuki pottery. On a stopover, they take a stroll to see the mythical capital, Shigaraki-no-miya, as told to them by local people. A delicious lunch using fresh Omi rice cooked in a pot. At the suspension bridge by Tsumekakeji-mae Station, they find an excellent railway photo spot. Along the way, they meet a train-stamp meister, making for a rich journey. As a result, the Shigaraki Railway train stamp will have to wait until next time. The sisters' local train journey continues. More

programme.title: We’re Starting Our Tetsuinchō (私たち鉄印帳はじめます)
programme.desc: 2021 — Set off on a freewheeling journey to collect "Tetsuin" stamps on local railway lines across Japan! Like collecting goshuin, "Tetsuin" can be collected on local railway lines run by 40 companies nationwide. It began through cooperation between railway companies and related firms that joined the Third Sector Railway Association, with the aim of revitalizing communities along regional railway lines. In this program... two actresses take you on a carefree Tetsuin-collecting journey, with beautiful camera imagery and carefully selected music. "Tetsuincho," the railway version of a goshuincho. The Takahashi Maryjun-Yuu sisters head back to their hometown in Shiga in search of Tetsuin, part two. At Tamakyuji Temple beyond the suspension bridge from the previous episode, they see a huge Dainichi Fudō Myōō. At their destination, Shigaraki Station, they are greeted by lots of tanuki ceramic figures. They receive two kinds of Tetsuin. In the Shigaraki town overflowing with tanuki pottery everywhere, they relax at a scarlet climbing-kiln café. And they finish with the long-awaited Omi beef shabu-shabu in this thoroughly enjoyable local line trip through Shiga. More

programme.title: Drinking Around Kyoto with the Old Guys (おやじ京都呑み)
programme.desc: 2022 — Kado-chan Takuzo, who loves Kyoto, and Kondo Yoshimasa, who moved to Kyoto—two distinctive actors go bar-hopping through Kyoto in search of fine drinks and snacks! Kado-chan Takuzo, a Kyoto connoisseur, stays in Kyoto more than 60 days a year. Meanwhile, Kondo Yoshimasa started his "Kyoto life" in 2020 after getting married. What happens when these two uniquely charismatic actors, both captivated by Kyoto, go drinking around town!? --- A new-style gourmet entertainment show about middle-aged men set in Kyoto! From hard-to-book popular spots to hidden gems known only to insiders, and casual izakaya to stop by on a whim --- we introduce a wide variety of places across all kinds of cuisine and teach you the style of drinking in Kyoto. This program began with Kondo Yoshimasa learning the ways of "oyaji nomi" from Kado-chan Takuzo. This time’s theme is "stamina dishes to get through the summer." Kyoto’s hot, hot summer. They go bar-hopping in an attempt to get through an even harsher-than-usual summer with stamina-building food! Once they’ve built up their energy at famous spots serving Sichuan cuisine, Korean food, and miso nikomi nabe, the drinks go down easier and the conversation with the people who run these family businesses really takes off! By the time they leave the restaurant, they may even have forgotten the heat!? Enjoy this fun summer day with the middle-aged guys! See more

programme.title: We’re Starting Our Tetsuinchō (私たち鉄印帳はじめます)
programme.desc: 2021 — Set off on a carefree "Tetsuin"-collecting journey aboard local train lines across Japan! Like collecting "goshuin," the "Tetsuin" can be collected on local lines operated by 40 companies nationwide. It was launched through cooperation between railway companies and related firms affiliated with the Third-sector Railway Association, with the aim of revitalizing communities along regional rail lines. In this program..., two actresses take you on a free-spirited Tetsuin-collecting journey, captured with beautiful footage from a single-lens camera and carefully selected music. A railway version of the goshuincho, the "Tetsuincho." Maryjun Takahashi and Nori Satō, a close-knit actress duo, travel through a world of silver, on the second day of their Iwate Galaxy Railway journey. Enjoy the spectacular view of snow-covered Mt. Iwate, then sledding in the snow and a warm lunch at the ski resort near Okunakayama Kogen Station. Could they find good fortune at Kindaichi Onsen Station, where legends of zashiki-warashi are passed down? More

programme.title: We’re Starting Our Tetsuinchō (私たち鉄印帳はじめます)
programme.desc: 2021 — A carefree trip collecting "tetsuin" on local railway lines across Japan! Like collecting "goshuin," these "tetsuin" can be collected on 40 local rail companies across the country. They were launched through cooperation between railway companies and related firms belonging to the Third-sector Railway Association, with the aim of promoting communities along local railway lines. This program... brings you the carefree tetsuin-collecting journey of two actresses, with beautiful single-lens camera footage and carefully selected music. The railway version of a goshuin book, the "tetsuincho." The friendly actress duo Maryjun Takahashi and Nori Sato cross the Tsugaru Strait and head to Donan Isaribi Railway in search of the only tetsuin in Hokkaido. Along the coastal line, stunning views continue with Hakodateyama on the horizon at the end. In Kikonai, they encounter a surprising ritual at Saegawa Shrine, where people train by dousing themselves in cold water in the middle of winter. After getting off at Oshima Tobe Station, they enjoy the beautiful scenery leading to Trappist Monastery at the end of an endlessly stretching snowy road. At the final stop, Goryokaku Station, they receive the Donan Isaribi Railway tetsuin, the first one in the tetsuincho. In Hakodate, they savor exquisite Hokkaido sushi at the town's oldest sushi restaurant. This is a girls' local-line trip, enjoying scenery that looks like overseas, dressed in pure white snow. See more

programme.desc: 2021 — Go on a freewheeling train stamp-collecting trip on local lines all across Japan! Like collecting "goshuin", "train stamps" can be collected on 40 local railway lines across the country. The project began through cooperation between railway companies and affiliated companies belonging to the Third Sector Railway Council, with the aim of promoting communities along local rail lines. This program... brings you the free-spirited stamp-collecting journey of two actresses, with beautiful single-lens camera footage and carefully curated music. The railway version of a goshuincho, the "train stamp book". Sisters Maryjun Takahashi and Yuu Takahashi travel to the westernmost railway line in Japan, Matsuura Railway, in search of train stamps. This time, starting in Arita, Saga Prefecture, they enjoy the spring scenery and local delicacies all the way to Tabila-Hirado-guchi Station, the westernmost station in Japan. At Aji Fry's sacred site, Matsuura Station, they have a fluffy, crispy aji fry set meal. They visit a farm to enjoy strawberry picking, and on Hirado Island they savor seasonal flounder. Show more

programme.title: Drama: A Tour Guide to the World (ドラマ地球の歩き方)
programme.desc: The travel bible "Chikyu no Arukikata" meets travel-loving celebrities! In this new-style overseas travel drama, travel-loving celebrities explore the hidden charms of Korea, Thailand, Saipan, and New Zealand. Commissioned by the editorial department of "Chikyu no Arukikata" to create a feature, four celebrity writers set off for their destinations... Following their curiosity to places they have always wanted to visit or once passed through, they roam local spots on foot, encountering new food, scenery, landmarks, and people, and recording them in photographs. In the end, the celebrity writer discovers the country’s new appeal and completes an original feature article. There are troubles, there are encounters---"Chikyu no Arukikata" contains not just information, but the raw travel experiences of the writers. ★Ayaka Miyoshi in Korea "Famous omoni special Seoul–Jeju Island" ★Mirai Moriyama in Thailand "Feature on the epicenter of contemporary art Bangkok–Chiang Rai–Phuket" ★Marika Matsumoto in Saipan "Special on the rainbow sea and spirits Saipan Island–Managaha Island–Tinian Island" ★Naotaro Moriyama in New Zealand "A special on Māori sacred sites by camper van Auckland–Cape Reinga" <Chikyu no Arukikata> Since its launch in 1979, titles covering more than 160 countries and regions have been published, supported by detailed local reporting from more than 200 writers and reporters. Even in the smartphone era, it has sold over 80 million copies in total, making it a kind of "textbook for overseas travel." Despite facing a crisis when sales fell by 90% during the COVID-19 pandemic, the series staged a remarkable comeback by releasing collaboration books with "Monthly Mu," "JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure," and "Wednesday’s Downtown," and in 2022 launched its first domestic editions, starting with "Tokyo" and then "Japan," which became huge hits, achieving a V-shaped recovery and recording its best-ever sales. Actress-model Ayaka Miyoshi receives a request from the editorial department of "Chikyu no Arukikata" to write a feature article as a celebrity reporter and decides to visit Korea. Miyoshi, who has visited Korea 50 times, chooses the theme "Famous omoni special." Upon arrival, she immediately visits her regular seafood stall run by sister omoni... More

programme.title: Drama: A Tour Guide to the World (ドラマ地球の歩き方)
programme.desc: The travel bible "Chikyu no Arukikata" teams up with travel-loving celebrities! In a new-style overseas travel drama, celebrity travel writers explore the little-known charms of Korea, Thailand, Saipan and New Zealand. Commissioned by the editorial team of "Chikyu no Arukikata" to create special feature pages, four celebrity writers set off for their destinations... Following their curiosity to places they have always wanted to visit or once passed through, they tour local spots on foot, encounter new food, scenery, landmarks and people, and capture them in photos. Then the celebrity writers discover fresh charms of each country and complete their original feature pages. With trouble and encounters along the way---"Chikyu no Arukikata" is not just packed with information, but also with the writers' real travel experiences. ★Ayaka Miyoshi in Korea "Special Feature on Famous Omoni, Seoul to Jeju Island" ★Mirai Moriyama in Thailand "Special Feature on the Epicenter of Contemporary Art, Bangkok to Chiang Rai to Phuket" ★Marika Matsumoto in Saipan "Special Feature on the Rainbow Sea and Spirits, Saipan Island to Managaha Island to Tinian Island" ★Naotaro Moriyama in New Zealand "Special Feature on Maori Sacred Sites by Camper Van, Auckland to Cape Reinga" <Chikyu no Arukikata> Since its launch in 1979, titles for more than 160 countries and regions have been published, and the series has been supported by information gathered through meticulous on-site reporting by more than 200 writers and journalists in total. Even in the smartphone age, it remains a kind of "textbook for overseas travel," boasting cumulative sales of over 80 million copies. After facing a crisis when sales fell by 90% during the COVID-19 pandemic, it staged a remarkable V-shaped recovery by releasing collaboration books with "Monthly MU," "JoJo's Bizarre Adventure," and "Wednesday's Downtown." Then in 2022, it launched its first domestic edition with "Tokyo," followed by "Japan," which became a huge hit. Not only did it recover brilliantly, it also recorded its highest-ever sales. Ayaka Miyoshi, the actress-model continuing her coverage of "Famous Omoni," visits an esthetic salon on her second day in Korea after being introduced to an omoni by a friend who works at her regular cafe. Miyoshi also interviews an omoni who designs hanbok, and that night she hears the earnest feelings of the local coordinator... More

programme.title: Tetsuota Michiko, 20,000 Kilometers (鉄オタ道子、2万キロ)
programme.desc: 2022 — Tina Tamashiro becomes a railfan girl! A travel drama set at local stations is born! Michiko Okaneku (Tina Tamashiro) works as a planning sales representative for a famous furniture maker. Trauma from an incident with her ex-boyfriend in the past has left her with another side she cannot reveal to those around her... That is, ...she has been a devoted railfan for 10 years! Whenever she has time, Michiko boards a train alone and travels to quiet local stations scattered around Japan, far from the cities. This omnibus-style travel drama follows her search for her true self while enjoying the people she meets, the scenery and exquisite gourmet food along the way. Michiko Okaneku (Tina Tamashiro), a devoted railfan of 10 years, works busily as a planning sales representative for a famous furniture maker, but when she has time, she sets off alone in search of local stations. Michiko arrives at Hiraifu Station in Hokkaido, the only station in Japan where you can stay overnight, and is deeply moved by its weathered signboard, the atmosphere of the station building, and the view from the minshuku. Then, as Michiko heads to the minshuku lobby, she spots Kai (Rui Kurihara), a young man she has noticed several times since arriving at the station... More

Whenever she has time, Michiko boards a train alone and travels to quiet local stations scattered around Japan, far from the cities. This omnibus-style travel drama follows her search for her true self while enjoying the people she meets, the scenery and exquisite gourmet food along the way. Okaneku Michiko (Tina Tamashiro), a devoted railfan of 10 years, sets off alone in search of local stations whenever she has time. Arriving at Oga Kogen Station, a station with fewer than 100 users a year, Michiko is stunned by how lacking in atmosphere it is. After walking around the station area and finding there is nowhere in particular to go, Michiko has no choice but to sit on a nearby bench and eat the ekiben she bought earlier. More
